Her leadership extends to overseeing a dedicated team of Operations Associates, where she fosters a culture of accountability and continuous improvement. Born on September 18, 1977, in Newton, Iowa, Haines found her passion for communication at an early age. She attended Smith College in Northampton, Massachusetts, where she pursued a Bachelor of Arts degree in Government. It was during her college years that Haines discovered her love for broadcast journalism, realizing that she had a natural flair for engaging storytelling. She went on to earn a Master's degree in Broadcast Journalism from Northwestern University's Medill School of Journalism, further honing her skills and preparing herself for a successful career in the industry.  
  
Haines began her professional journey in the world of news, working at the NBC Page Program in New York. Her hard work and dedication soon paid off, leading her to secure various positions at notable television networks, including ABC News. In 2013, Haines joined the cast of the widely popular daytime talk show, "The View," where she quickly became a fan favorite. Her ability to deliver intelligent, thought-provoking ideas while still embracing her playful side endeared her to both the panelists and viewers. Leaving "The View" briefly in 2016, Haines teamed up with Michael Strahan and joined the cast of "Good Morning America" as a pop news anchor, injecting the show with her energetic presence and infectious enthusiasm. However, she ultimately returned to "The View" in 2018, solidifying her status as an integral part of the show's success. Her genuine camaraderie with her co-hosts and her ability to provide insightful commentary on the day's hot topics continued to captivate audiences, making her a central figure on the show for many years.  
  
Haines expanded her television portfolio when she joined the team at ABC's daytime talk show "Strahan & Sara" in 2018. The show became an instant hit, earning a loyal following and showcasing Haines' versatility as a host.  
  
In 2020, Haines embarked on a new venture as the host of her very own daytime talk show titled "The Sara Haines Show." The show, which airs on ABC,allows Haines to showcase her vibrant personality and her ability to connect with guests from all walks of life. Known for her empathetic nature, she creates a comfortable and supportive environment for her guests to share their stories, making the show a platform for inspiration and entertainment.  
  
Beyond her television work, Haines is a devoted wife and mother. She married lawyer Max Shifrin in 2014, and together they have three children. Haines often shares glimpses of her family life on social media, offering fans a relatable view into her world.  
  
Whether discussing hard-hitting news topics, engaging in lighthearted banter, or providing insightful commentary, Sara Haines has established herself as a prominent voice in the world of television hosting and journalism. The Center for Innovation, Excellence and Leadership (IXL Center) is focused on delivering breakthrough and high-performance results, building lasting innovation capabilities, and researching and codifying best practices in innovation management.  
  
We develop innovative business solutions and capabilities of leaders, teams and organizations. We help organizations get started with powerful audits and learning histories, and we work across the entire spectrum from sourcing and idea generation, through concept development and pressure testing, to accelerated pilots, launch, and scale-up. IXL Center was created by the practice innovation leaders of Arthur D. Little and Monitor Group, business school professors from Hult International Business School and industry practitioners.  
  
Our leadership at IXL has been focused on the innovation space for over 30 years, and we continue to develop cutting-edge innovation tools and methods and integrate them into our IXL Eureka software to support innovation leaders and drive effective collaboration worldwide. We also teach innovation and provide certification opportunities to thousands of corporate executives and MBA students using a powerful blended action learning and online curriculum.  
  
We serve our clients through a global footprint of eleven consulting offices and training locations in four continents.

About Belmond El Encanto
------------------------

Perched high in the Santa Barbara hills, this iconic hideaway offers the best views of the American Riviera. Spread across seven acres of secluded gardens, El Encanto opened in 1918 and has been part of Santa Barbara’s social scene ever since. The resort is gleaming and glamorous, yet relaxed and low key. The kind of place that invites you to recline poolside, breathe in the ocean air, and sip a glass of crisp local wine.  
  
Ninety-two quintessential, California-styled suites and bungalows dot the lush, terraced grounds featuring seven-acres of gloriously landscaped gardens with sweeping views of Santa Barbara and the Pacific Ocean.  
  
Original architectural features have been lovingly restored, including the historic, trellis-lined Arbor and Lily Pond. Modern additions to the expansive outdoor zero-edge pool and a new beautifully appointed boutique spa enhance the journey for today’s luxury-seeking guest.

Whether it was quarterbacking the power play, killing penalties, or stepping up in crucial moments, Daniel Sedin consistently demonstrated his ability to elevate his game and make a positive impact for his team.  
  
Beyond his individual accomplishments, Daniel Sedin's impact on the Vancouver Canucks and the NHL as a whole cannot be overstated. About Innovation Centre Nikola Tesla (ICENT)
--------------------------------------------

Innovation Centre Nikola TESLA (ICENT) is a non-profit institution whose function is to enable and accelerate efficient commercialization of new technologies in areas critical for the development of Croatian economy. The vision is for ICENT to become a leading innovation eco-system in the Dunav region, specialised for applied research and development in the area of engineering and with a strong support of ICT technology its aim is to strengthen Croatian society and economy towards competitiveness and sustainability. Primary function of the ICENT is lowering the risk of developing new and innovative products by using ICENT’s expert staff, state-of-the-art equipment and infrastructure to bridge the gap between research institutions and the industry. The risk is lowered by taking over the development of α- and β-prototypes and early-stage manufacturing processes using government or industrial funding to: (i) release products to start-up companies financed using venture capital or (ii) further government funding all with the goal of new technologies commercialization. ICENTs technological pillars comprise of: Institute for Energetics: wind energy, solar power, energy storage, energy efficiency, microgrids and smart grids Institute for Transport Systems: application of ICT, electrical and mechanical systems on vehicles (automotive, train and ships), energy efficiency, ecologically acceptable transport, management and monitoring of traffic and multimodal traffic systems Institute for Robotics: autonomous navigation of mobile robots and vehicles, management of robots for naval research, cooperate management of multiple robot systems, management and navigation of autonomous flying vehicles, cognitive manipulation of objects, object recognition, cognitive visual systems and interaction between robots and humans Institute for Biomedical Engineering: biomedical instrumentation, measurements and sensors, biomedical image capture (ultrasound, CT, MRI, X-ray), data acquisition and processing (signal and images), bioinformatics and computing genomics, analysis of movement and electrophysiology Institute for Advanced Components Technology: optical and electronic elements based on new materials, advanced electronic devices for communications, analog and mixed signal integrated circuits in nanometer and micrometer scale technologies, thermal management, electromagnetic compatibility, metamaterials with application in THz domain and optical spectrum for communications Institute for ICT: new-generation communication networks and services, advanced digital technologies, new internet networks, architectures and services, new storage technologies, technologies for processing and distribution of content and media, and new technologies for safe and sustainable society Through its work ICENT will contribute to the growth of the economy based on high technologies primarily in the sectors of energy, transport, automation and robotics, advanced components, healthcare-biomedical engineering and information and communication technology. A path for the scientific community to commercialise research results will be created accompanied with growth in interdisciplinary activities within the community.

About Blue Bird Corporation
---------------------------

About Us  
  
Blue Bird offers a complete line of Type A, C and D school buses in a variety of options and configurations. Since 1927, Blue Bird Corporation has continued to set industry standards with its innovative design and manufacturing capabilities. Additionally, Blue Bird provides comprehensive financial solutions through Blue Bird Capital Services. Today, Blue Bird has more than 1,600 employees, Georgia-based manufacturing facilities and an extensive network of Dealers and Parts & Service facilities throughout North America. Its global presence can be seen in more than 60 countries through sales into Africa, Asia, the Caribbean, Latin America, Europe and the Middle East.  
  
Our Promise  
  
We are singularly focused on building and selling school buses that customers want and value. The safety of schoolchildren is at the center of all that we do and we will strive every day, just as we have since our beginning in 1927, to provide an unparalleled and affordable product in terms of safety, quality, durability, and serviceability. We will be easy to do business with, responsive to our customers'​ wants and needs, and provide prompt after-sale support in parts and service through a professional, high-qualified distribution network. Customer satisfaction is our top priority.  
  
What We Stand For  
  
We come to work every day with one common goal, to design, build, sell and service the world's finest school bus. That's what we do - no distractions, no competing priorities. We are heirs to a rich legacy, one of listening to our customers, embracing their needs, and delivering innovations that lead the market.  
  
We commit ourselves to four driving priorities - safety, quality, durability, and serviceability. We embody the interests of every child that rides us, every driver that drives us, every service technician that services us and every district that buys us. More than a business, this work is our heritage, and we have been at it since 1927 - that's purpose driven.

About Chelsea and Westminster Hospital NHS Foundation Trust
-----------------------------------------------------------

Chelsea and Westminster Hospital NHS Foundation Trust runs two main hospitals:  
  
• Chelsea and Westminster Hospital  
• West Middlesex University Hospital  
  
We also offer a range of community based services, including our award winning sexual health and HIV clinics across London:  
  
• 56 Dean Street and Dean Street Express in Soho  
• West London Centre for Sexual Health at Charing Cross Hospital  
• John Hunter Clinic and Kobler Clinic at St Stephen's Centre adjacent to the main hospital site  
• Sexual Health Hounslow  
• A number of innovative outreach HIV and sexual health services in the local community  
  
The Trust has over 6,000 staff proudly serving a million people locally, regionally, nationally and internationally. We treat a patient every 40 seconds, performing 34,000 operations and carrying out 391,000 scans, x-rays and procedures each year. As the second largest maternity provider in the country we help deliver a baby almost every hour of the day.  
  
Our Trust has been rated by the Care Quality Commission as ‘Good’ in all five of the main domains of safe, effective, caring, responsive and well-led, giving an us overall rating of ‘Good’. We are one of the first trusts to receive ‘Good’ across the board under the new CQC inspection framework. Both hospitals within our Trust—Chelsea and Westminster Hospital and West Middlesex University Hospital—were rated as ‘Good’ overall.  
  
Our Trust was awarded an ‘Outstanding’ rating for ‘use of resources’ by an NHS Improvement inspection which was completed during the same period as the CQC assessment.

About IPC Europe (European Independent Purchasing Company Limited)
------------------------------------------------------------------

IPC Europe, officially known as IPC EMEA (European Independent Purchasing Company Limited), was established in 2001 with the mission of empowering Subway Franchisees to maximize their purchasing power. By leveraging collective buying strength, IPC Europe enables its members to access significant discounts on a wide range of products and services, enhancing profitability and operational efficiency. Headquartered in High Wycombe, Bucks, the organization has evolved alongside the Subway brand, expanding its geographic reach and service offerings to meet the dynamic needs of Franchisees across Europe.  
  
IPC Europe specializes in procurement and supply chain management, focusing on delivering high-quality food and non-food products essential for the fast-food industry. The company’s extensive portfolio includes everything from fresh ingredients and packaging solutions to equipment and maintenance supplies. By employing advanced procurement strategies and technologies, IPC Europe ensures that Franchisees benefit from competitive pricing and reliable supply chains, ultimately driving value and quality in their operations.  
  
In addition to traditional purchasing services, IPC Europe is committed to fostering innovation within the industry. The organization actively explores new technologies and sustainable practices to enhance product offerings and streamline operations for its members. By staying attuned to market trends and Franchisee feedback, IPC Europe continues to adapt and grow, solidifying its role as a vital partner in the success of Subway Franchisees throughout the EMEA region. With a focus on collaboration and efficiency, IPC Europe remains dedicated to delivering exceptional value and support to its members in an ever-evolving marketplace.

About Oriental Trading Company
------------------------------

Oriental Trading Company has one simple mission: to make life more fun. For individuals, nonprofits, churches and schools, we provide countless reasons to share smiles while making all of life's moments more special.  
  
With more than 40,000 unique products, we're the nation's largest direct retailer of value-priced party supplies, toys and crafts as well as a leading provider of fundraising products. Headquartered in Omaha, Nebraska, Oriental Trading has continued its long-standing commitment to excellent customer service, even being recognized by Foresee as one of the Top 20 Internet Retailers based on customer satisfaction. Additionally, Oriental Trading has been rated one of the Top 100 Online Retailers by Internet Retailer.  
  
Our history with fun is one that spans for the better part of the last century. Founded in 1932, we became a major supplier of novelties to the U.S. carnival trade in the 1950s before expanding in the succeeding decades through catalogs, direct marketing and eventually the internet in 1999.  
  
In 2012, Warren Buffett's Berkshire Hathaway saw tremendous value and growth opportunity in Oriental Trading and made the decision to purchase our company. Shortly after, Oriental Trading acquired two companies that aligned with our mission: MindWare, a manufacturer, wholesaler and direct retailer of “brainy toys for kids of all ages,” and SmileMakers, a leading brand specializing in patient giveaways and promotion products for dental and healthcare markets. To better meet the needs of our customers, Oriental Trading created several new brands in 2017; Marry Me, Fun365, and CustomFun365.  
  
For over 85 years, we've helped friends and families around the world spark imaginations and celebrate special moments. Spreading fun one smile at a time? That's our specialty!  
  
Ready to Make Your Career More Fun? Learn more at MyOTCCareer.com.

Ashley Tisdale: A Multitalented Icon of the Entertainment Industry

Born on July 2, 1985, in Monmouth County, New Jersey, Ashley Michelle Tisdale discovered her passion for performing at a young age. With her striking looks and natural talent, it was clear that she was destined for stardom. Her journey towards success began in the early 2000s when she landed her breakout role as Maddie Fitzpatrick in the wildly popular Disney Channel series, "The Suite Life of Zack & Cody."  
  
Tisdale's portrayal of the lovable, quirky hotel employee endeared her to audiences of all ages. Her impeccable comedic timing and electric on-screen presence earned her a well-deserved Young Artist Award in 2006. This was just the beginning of her illustrious career.  
  
In 2006, Tisdale joined another Disney Channel hit, "High School Musical," where she played the role of Sharpay Evans, the iconic pink-loving, diva-like theater queen. Tisdale's magnetic performance garnered critical acclaim and turned her into an instant fan favorite. The success of the franchise propelled her towards international stardom, as she and her fellow cast members embarked on a sold-out concert tour, releasing chart-topping soundtracks that took the world by storm.  
  
The undeniable talent that Tisdale possessed as an actress seamlessly extended into her music career. In 2007, she released her debut album, "Headstrong," which showcased her powerful vocals and dynamic musical style. The album's lead single, "He Said She Said," became an instant hit, reaching the top ten on various charts worldwide. Tisdale's unique blend of pop and rock influences made her stand out from her peers, solidifying her status as a versatile artist.  
  
Continuing her musical journey, Tisdale released her second studio album, "Guilty Pleasure," in 2009. Straying away from her earlier pop sound, the album embraced a more mature and edgy style, allowing Tisdale to showcase her growth as an artist. The album's lead single, "It's Alright, It's OK," became a fan favorite, with its empowering lyrics and infectious melody.  
  
While Tisdale was thriving in her music career, she never abandoned her passion for acting. She took on various roles in both TV shows and movies, proving her versatility as an actress. In 2010, she starred in the comedy film "Sharpay's Fabulous Adventure," a spin-off of "High School Musical," which showcased her beloved character's journey towards her dreams of fame and stardom.  
  
Tisdale's talent and work ethic continued to shine as she expanded her horizon beyond the Disney Channel. She appeared in the critically acclaimed TV series "Sons of Anarchy" in 2012, exploring her range as an actress by delving into more dramatic and adult-oriented roles. Her portrayal of Emma Jean in the show was a testament to her versatility and ability to tackle any character with conviction.  
  
In recent years, Tisdale has kept herself busy by exploring new avenues and embracing motherhood. She has launched her own successful lifestyle brand, "Frenshe," focusing on holistic wellness and self-care. Through her platform, Tisdale aims to inspire and empower others to prioritize their well-being in all aspects of life.  
  
Ashley Tisdale's magnetic charm, unwavering dedication, and unmatched talent have solidified her status as a beloved icon of the entertainment industry. About Catch Hospitality Group
-----------------------------

One of the country’s most successful restaurant management companies, Catch Hospitality Group (CHG) has spent two decades pioneering dynamic hospitality experiences using food, service and vibe to create seamless transitions between dining and entertainment in marquee brands including Catch (2011) and Catch Steak (2019). Catch (2011) has grown from a standalone NYC flagship to a multi-unit, brand-driven icon with successful locations in Los Angeles and Las Vegas at the ARIA Resort & Casino. Sister concept Catch Steak (2019) debuted in New York, with highly anticipated locations slated in Aspen and Los Angeles for 2021.  
  
In 2017, CATCH partnered with hospitality business mogul Tilman Fertitta, who’s privately owned Landry’s, Inc. is ranked among the largest restaurant corporations in the U.S. Fertitta has spent 30 years cultivating his hospitality empire of over 600 locations into an international success and has joined Catch Hospitality Group co-founders Eugene Remm and Mark Birnbaum in the expansion of the brands with a focus on building the best team of talent in each market.

About Jackmont Hospitality Inc
------------------------------

Jackmont Hospitality is an award-winning, minority-owned foodservice management company and one of the fastest growing TGI FRIDAYS® franchisees. We own and operate restaurants throughout the country on behalf of Atlanta Restaurant Partners\* (ARP). Additionally, we oversee on-site foodservice management contracts throughout the United States in the following segments:  
  
Airport Concessions  
Healthcare Foodservice  
School District Dining Programs  
  
The spirit behind Jackmont Hospitality was born out of the 1930's home and small family resort of the late Maynard H. Jackson, Jr., former Atlanta mayor. “Jackson's Mountain” provided a retreat for family and friends to enjoy good food and warm, attentive hospitality. Today, Jackmont Hospitality combines the hospitality quality of yesteryear with a modern approach to business and industry solutions.  
  
\*Atlanta Restaurant Partners (ARP) was formed in 2003 and is an Atlanta-based franchisee and food-service management company. Jackmont Hospitality provides management services for ARP.  
  
Vision and Mission  
  
VISION  
To be the most sought after hospitality company!  
  
MISSION  
To provide a fun and rewarding environment for our team, our guests and the communities we serve.  
  
GUIDING PRINCIPLES  
  
Passion for Excellence  
We believe in what we do and strive to do it better than anyone else. Our relentless pursuit of excellence paves our path to growth, profitability and success. We go the extra mile to exceed expectations and drive our guests to return, again and again.  
  
Entrepreneurial Spirit  
We foster an environment that encourages freedom and personal accountability. We expect our team to innovate solutions that help us achieve our mission and excel in the marketplace.  
  
Continuous Learning and Development

How can I contact Project Access for inquiries about services?

You can reach Project Access by visiting our website at www.project-access.org and using the 'Contact Us' form. Alternatively, you can call our main office at the number listed on the site for immediate assistance regarding our services.

Is there a directory of staff members at Project Access?

Yes, you can find a list of our dedicated staff members on the Project Access website. Navigate to the 'About Us' section, where you’ll find information about our team and their respective roles in supporting our community services.

What types of services does Project Access provide?

Project Access offers a range of services including health and wellness programs, educational support, youth programs, and employment services. Our goal is to empower families and individuals in affordable housing communities to achieve economic stability and independent living.

Who can I speak to about specific programs for seniors?

For inquiries related to our senior services, please contact our Senior Program Coordinator through the contact information provided on our website. They can provide details about programs designed to promote independent living and wellness for seniors.

How do I get involved with Project Access as a volunteer?

To volunteer with Project Access, visit our website and navigate to the 'Get Involved' section. There, you can find information on current volunteer opportunities and how to apply. We welcome individuals passionate about making a difference in our communities.

Can I request a presentation about Project Access services for my organization?

Absolutely! If you're interested in a presentation about our services, please contact us through the 'Contact Us' form on our website. Provide details about your organization and the audience, and we will arrange a suitable time to discuss our mission and programs.

Duncan Keith's contributions to the sport of hockey are undeniable, and his legacy as a defenseman will forever be etched in the annals of the NHL. About Jackie Chan

Jackie Chan - Actor and Filmmaker  
  
Jackie Chan is a globally acclaimed actor and filmmaker who has captivated audiences with his incredible martial arts skills, charismatic on-screen presence, and unique blend of action-packed comedy. Born Chan Kong-sang on April 7, 1954, in Hong Kong, he grew up in a poor family and began his journey in the entertainment industry as a child actor. Since then, Jackie Chan has evolved into an international movie star, renowned for his daredevil stunts, impeccable timing, and infectious charm.  
  
Chan's career in the film industry spans over five decades, and he has starred in more than 150 films. He first gained recognition in the 1970s with his roles in Bruce Lee's "Enter the Dragon" and "Fists of Fury." However, it was his unique style of blending martial arts with comedy that set him apart. Jackie Chan's films are not only action-packed but also infused with lightheartedness, making them highly enjoyable for audiences worldwide.  
  
One of Chan's trademarks is his ability to perform his own stunts and high-risk action sequences. Unlike many actors who rely on stunt doubles, Jackie Chan truly pushes the boundaries of what is physically possible, often putting himself at great risk for the sake of delivering awe-inspiring scenes. His dedication and fearlessness have earned him a well-deserved reputation as one of the most fearless and skilled action stars in the industry.  
  
Apart from his incredible physical abilities, Chan's success as an actor and filmmaker can be attributed to his strong work ethic and commitment to his craft. He approaches each role with immense dedication, spending countless hours perfecting fight choreography and rehearsing complex scenes. He is known for his attention to detail, often directing his own movies and making important creative decisions to ensure the final product aligns with his vision.  
  
In addition to his acting prowess, Jackie Chan has also directed and produced several successful films. Notably, his directorial debut, "The Young Master" in 1980, showcased his versatility as a filmmaker. He meticulously choreographed fight scenes, wove intricate storylines, and injected his signature comedic style, displaying his ability to bring a film to life from behind the camera.  
  
Chan has also demonstrated his passion for giving back to society through various charitable endeavors. He founded the Jackie Chan Charitable Foundation in 1988, which provides scholarships, aid to disaster-stricken areas, and assistance to those in need. Additionally, he is a UNICEF Goodwill Ambassador, advocating for children's rights and promoting education globally. Jackie Chan's philanthropic efforts and commitment to social causes have further elevated his status as not just a talented artist but also a compassionate humanitarian.  
  
While he is primarily recognized for his action-comedy films, Jackie Chan has also dabbled in different genres, including drama and historical epics. In 2004, he starred in the critically acclaimed film "New Police Story," in which he showcased his ability to take on a darker and more serious role. His versatility as an actor has allowed him to continually reinvent himself, captivating audiences with his ability to take on diverse characters.  
  
Over the course of his career, Jackie Chan has received numerous accolades for his contributions to the film industry. In 2016, he was awarded an honorary Oscar for his extraordinary achievements and his unique blend of thrilling action and comedy. This recognition was a testament to his impact on global cinema and his ability to entertain audiences for generations.  
  
In conclusion, Jackie Chan's journey from a struggling child actor to an international superstar is a true testament to his talent, determination, and unmatched dedication. With his awe-inspiring stunts, unparalleled comedic timing, and charismatic on-screen presence, he has become an icon in the world of cinema. Chan's unique blend of action, comedy, and heart has made him a beloved figure, transcending borders and captivating audiences worldwide. He continues to leave an indelible mark on the film industry and inspires future generations with his unmatched passion for his craft and his commitment to making a positive impact on society.

Nuestra historia comienza en 1987, cuando Pere Gallés, un panadero visionario, apostó por la tecnología del frío para satisfacer las necesidades de los consumidores y profesionales de la panadería y la restauración. Desde entonces, diferentes acontecimientos nos han llevado a convertirnos en una de las compañías más expertas y punteras del sector de las masas congeladas de pan, bollería, pastelería y snacks.  
  
Nuestra historia demuestra nuestros orígenes, los que están arraigados a la panadería tradicional. La perseverancia y el cuidado son nuestros aliados. La naturaleza, nuestra inspiración. La tradición, el punto de partida. Pero también somos inconformistas: la innovación es nuestra fuerza impulsora, nuestro mantra.  
  
Creemos en la persistencia, en la creatividad, en el dinamismo. Actuamos comprometidos con todo lo que hacemos, especialmente con el medio ambiente y las personas. Creemos que nuestro impacto en el mundo puede marcar la diferencia y trabajamos duro para dejar una impronta positiva.  
  
\-  
  
Our history goes back to 1987, when Pere Gallés, a visionary baker, embraced refrigeration technology to satisfy the needs of consumers and professionals in the bakery and food-service sectors. Since then, different events have made us one of the most expert and cutting-edge bakery companies in the sector of frozen doughs for bread, viennoiseries, pastries and snacks.  
  
Our history reveals our origins, which are rooted in traditional baking. Perseverance and care are our best allies. Nature, our inspiration. Tradition, our starting point. But we are also non-conformists: innovation is our driving force, our mantra.  
  
We believe in persistence, in creativity, in dynamism. We are committed to everything we do and especially to the environment and people. We believe that our impact on the world can make a difference and we work hard to leave a positive footprint.

About Reservisten Koninklijke Landmacht
---------------------------------------

Een militaire functie doen, zonder je huidige baan op te geven? Het kan! Duizenden reservisten combineren hun dagelijkse werk of studie met een parttime baan binnen Defensie.Een baan als reservist geeft je de kans om militaire ervaring op te doen en te werken met een groep zeer gemotiveerde mensen. Het is tenslotte vaak een ‘extra’ functie die reservisten doen, naast hun reguliere baan of studie.De meeste reservisten werken voornamelijk tijdens nationale operaties. Denk bijvoorbeeld aan de militaire hulp bij overstromingen en bosbranden, of de bewaking en beveiliging van strategische objecten. Maar uiteraard doen ze ook ‘groene’ oefeningen in het bos, vaak met andere eenheden van Defensie.Er is ook een groep reservisten met een specifieke deskundigheid. Dat zijn bijvoorbeeld tolken, juristen, ingenieurs, cyberreservisten of deskundigen op allerlei andere vakgebieden die van grote waarde kunnen zijn in missiegebieden in het buitenland, of tijdens rampenbestrijding in Nederland.Ben je geïnteresseerd om als reservist aan de slag te gaan, kijk dan op Werkenbijdefensie.nl om je aan te melden voor een voorlichting.Daarnaast is het mogelijk om als reservist tijdelijk voor 8 tot 32 uur werkzaamheden te verrichten binnen de organisatie. Ben je al reservist log dan in via de website ikbenreservist.nl en ontdek daar de mogelijkheden. Denk daarbij aan uitvragen zoals projectmanager, communicatie adviseur, magazijn medewerker, opleidings- en trainingsontwikkelaar, administratief medewerker, stafonderofficier logistiek.

### Frequently Asked Questions about SURFCAM

What is SURFCAM and what industries does it serve?

SURFCAM is a powerful 3D Computer-Aided Manufacturing (CAM) software designed to streamline the machining process for various industries. It serves sectors such as aerospace, automotive, medical device manufacturing, and general machining. SURFCAM provides solutions for wire EDM, milling, turning, and multi-axis machining, making it suitable for a wide range of applications.

What types of machining processes does SURFCAM support?

SURFCAM supports a variety of machining processes, including 2-axis, 3-axis, and 4/5-axis milling and turning. It also offers specialized support for wire EDM (Electrical Discharge Machining), allowing users to create complex geometries with precision. This versatility makes SURFCAM an ideal choice for manufacturers looking to optimize their machining capabilities.

How user-friendly is SURFCAM for new users?

SURFCAM is designed with an emphasis on ease of use, making it accessible for both novice and experienced users. The software features an intuitive interface and a comprehensive set of tools that allow users to quickly learn and apply the software to their machining processes. Additionally, SURFCAM offers extensive training resources and customer support to help users maximize their experience.

What are post processors and how does SURFCAM utilize them?

Post processors are essential components in CAM software that convert toolpath data into machine-specific code that can be executed by CNC machines. SURFCAM includes a wide range of customizable post processors to support various CNC machines and controllers, ensuring that users can efficiently translate their designs into actionable machining instructions tailored to their specific equipment.

Can SURFCAM integrate with other CAD software?

Yes, SURFCAM is designed to integrate seamlessly with various CAD software packages. This interoperability allows users to import designs from popular CAD programs, enabling a smooth workflow from design to manufacturing. SURFCAM supports common file formats, making it easy to transfer data and maintain design integrity throughout the machining process.

What kind of support and resources does SURFCAM provide to its users?

SURFCAM offers a range of support options, including online documentation, tutorials, and webinars to help users get started and troubleshoot any issues. Additionally, SURFCAM provides customer support through various channels, including phone and email, ensuring that users have access to assistance whenever they need it. The community forum also allows users to connect and share insights with fellow SURFCAM users.

About APPLIX Srl
----------------

Founded in 2010, Applix is a company focused on Customer Interaction through mobile solutions that enable brands, publishers and institutions to create an innovative and effective digital strategy.  
  
We are a strategic partner for some of the most important publishers and businesses, specialising in three main lines of business:  
Digital Publishing: we change publishing products into digital experiences. Our proprietary solutions allow to manage and distribute publishing products and content in a fluid and innovative way, monitoring all readers’ and customers’ activities.  
Mobile & Apps: we offer tailor-made solutions for the needs of each client. We make our experience, our technologies and our innovation skills available to turn any project into a customised mobile product.  
Education: we create and promote innovative solutions and platforms for the digital school. We develop products that accompany students and teachers in educational paths through specific tools that support the evolution of training activities.  
  
In 2011 our company gained a €3 million investment, underwritten by Principia 2 fund, the investment company AngelLab, Hyppo Corporation and private partners, laying the foundation for the roll-out and internationalisation of its products.  
  
In 2012 and 2014 we completed the acquisition of Xorovo S.r.l. and bSmart S.r.l., today Applix Xorovo and Applix Education, business units of the company: the former, specialising in the development of end user and enterprise solutions for mobile devices, the latter, focused on digital publishing services for education.  
  
Our Apps have received several international awards and have been downloaded in more than 120 countries, reaching the top 10 of the Stores ranking in over 50 of them with millions of downloads.  
  
Visit our website: www.applixgroup.com

Through "Merata," Winstanley pays tribute to her mother's legacy and continues her work of championing underrepresented voices in film.  
  
Winstanley's dedication to storytelling and her determination to challenge societal norms extend beyond the screen. About Emery Federal Credit Union
--------------------------------

Emery Federal Credit Union is a full service financial cooperative, dedicated to serving its Members. We’re a fast growing, progressive Credit Union that offers Members a full range of banking products and services, including deposit accounts, loan products/services, and commercial services.  
  
What is a Credit Union?  
Emery Federal Credit Union is a not-for-profit, Member-owned financial institution. Unlike banks, thrifts, and finance companies who operate on a “for profit” basis, we return excess earnings back to our Members in the form of lower loan interest rates, higher yield savings and investment accounts, and low or no fee convenience services in addition to the friendly, unmatched Member service we provide.  
  
As a not-for profit financial cooperative, we are dedicated to treating every Member as a part-owner in the Credit Union... because in reality you are. You can enjoy the benefits of the most competitive financial services you’ll find with the reassurance of knowing that your money is safe and secure by being Federally Insured through the National Credit Union Administration (NCUA).  
  
History of Emery FCU  
Emery Federal Credit Union was originally chartered in 1939 to serve Emery Industries. In 1984, we began to expand our field of membership to include other diverse groups.  
  
Since that time, we have grown an astounding 163% and offer four branch locations throughout the tri-state region. We are proud to serve the employees (and their family members) of over 350 companies.

About PJSC “UKRBUSINESSBANK”
----------------------------

Банк начал свою деятельность 19 мая 1993 года под названием «Сельскохозяйственный коммерческий банк «Сельхозбанк». На протяжении 1993-1999 гг. банк постепенно расширял спектр услуг и повышал уровень сервиса, получив репутацию стабильного и надежного финансового института. Со временем, с появлением новых акционеров, Банк меняет название на «Акционерный банк «Донеччина».  
В целом, 2000 год стал для Банка годом реализации инновационных программ, основой которых было внедрение прогрессивных банковских технологий. Этот период отмечается значительным расширением ресурсной и прибыльной базы, быстрыми темпами капитализации. В течение 2000 года уставный капитал Банка возрос в 4 раза.  
21 октября 2003 года общим собранием акционеров были приняты решения о переименовании банка в Акционерный Банк «Украинский Бизнес Банк».  
В июне 2009 года с Национальным банком Украины согласована новая редакция устава АБ «УкрБизнесБанк».  
В августе 2010 года АБ «УкрБизнесБанк» сменил наименование на ПУБЛИЧНОЕ АКЦИОНЕРНОЕ ОБЩЕСТВО «УКРАИНСКИЙ БИЗНЕС БАНК». ПАО «УКРБИЗНЕСБАНК» органично вписался в отечественный банковский бизнес как надёжная и стабильная банковская организация, которая активно расширяет сеть собственных учреждений, наращивает объемы активов и пассивов, постоянно вводит новые банковские продукты как для населения, так и для корпоративных клиентов.

About Drew University
---------------------

Drew University, a Phi Beta Kappa liberal arts university, includes the College of Liberal Arts, the Drew Theological School and the Caspersen School of Graduate Studies. Drew is located on a beautiful, wooded, 186-acre campus in Madison, New Jersey, a thriving small town close to New York City.  
  
It has a total enrollment of more than 2,000 students and has 145 full-time faculty members, 94% of whom hold the terminal degree in their field. The Theological and Caspersen schools offer MA and PhD degrees and the College confers BA degrees in more than 30 disciplines.  
  
Drew is dedicated to exceptional faculty mentorship, a commitment to connecting the campus with the community and a focus on experiential learning. Particularly noteworthy opportunities for undergraduates include the the Charles A. Dana Research Institute for Scientists Emeriti (RISE), home of 2015 Nobel Prize Winner for Medicine and Drew Fellow William Campbell, the Drew Summer Science Institute (DSSI), the Center for Civic Engagement, as well as New York City semesters focusing on Wall Street, the United Nations, Contemporary Art, Theatre, Social Entrepreneurship and Communications and Media in New York City and several international semester programs.  
  
Drew also houses the Center on Religion, Culture & Conflict, the Center for Holocaust/Genocide Study and the Shakespeare Theatre of New Jersey, an independent professional theater, as well as the United Methodist Archives and History Center and one of the country’s leading concentrations of materials on Willa Cather.

About Mad Engine
----------------

Mad Engine Global, LLC started as a production screen printing company. Now operating out of San Diego county in California, with extended manufacturing and sourcing capabilities in the U.S, Mexico, & all over the globe. Mad Engine is one of the leading Licensed Apparel wholesalers in the world. With a strong licensing roster of the worlds largest brands, including several TOP SELLING evergreen properties including Lucasfilm, Marvel, & Disney. Our artwork is used for style guide elements, and offered to other licenses worldwide. Mad Engine has earned a recognized position with all of the major retailers across the US & Canada such Walmart, Target, JCPenney, Kohl’s, Nordstrom, Bloomingdales, and more. Our Shelf Stock program keeps in house inventory to service the just in time inventory deliveries of over 400 items for smaller store chains and boutique sales.  
  
With an in house art staff of over 25 highly skilled and experienced artists, Mad Engine has proven to licensors and its customers that it is able to create unique & custom designs that cater to a wide array of audiences. Our Merchandising team helps keep floor presentations fresh & & coherent by retailer, & help them to design into POS displays such as Pallets, Trays, Tables & Rounders. The Company’s managed production schedules help meet the needs of any retailer, large or small. We excel in Quick turn product & On Time deliveries in accordance with vendor floor ready guidelines. We stay compliant with all State, Federal, & licensor requirements. Mad Engine is recognized as one of the top 5 suppliers for Licensed Apparel products in the U.S.A.

The philanthropic efforts of Novant Health’s foundations inspire giving that supports programs and initiatives having direct patient impact. Novant Health’s network consists of more than 1,500 physicians and over 26,000 team members who provide care at over 470 locations, including 14 medical centers and hundreds of outpatient facilities and physician clinics. Headquartered in Winston-Salem, North Carolina, the health system cares for more than 4.4 million patients annually in North Carolina, Virginia, South Carolina and Georgia.  
  
Our regional foundations focus on the critical needs in five areas: infants and children, cancer, heart and vascular, stroke and neurosciences, and research and education.  
  
Through the generous support of individuals, families, companies and grant-making institutions, we help Novant Health in its mission to improve the health of our communities, one person at a time.

Omada has enrolled nearly one million members across all 50 states. Our partners include Fortune 500 companies, health plans and health systems across the country.

About Kati Strong

Kati Strong serves as the Director of Youth Music Ministry at Tarrytown United Methodist Church, where she brings over fifteen years of dedicated experience in fostering independence and personal growth among youth. In her current role, Kati has successfully created and developed a vibrant youth band in collaboration with her husband, Joey Thompson. This initiative has not only enriched the church’s musical offerings but has also become a cornerstone of community engagement, allowing young musicians to explore their talents in a supportive environment.  
  
Kati leads weekly rehearsals for 6th to 12th graders, focusing on skill development, teamwork, and self-expression through music. Her expertise in program development and teaching is evident as she tailors each session to accommodate the diverse backgrounds and unique challenges of the participants. By integrating elements of diversity and inclusion into her curriculum, Kati ensures that every young adult feels valued and empowered to contribute their voice to the band.  
  
In addition to her musical leadership, Kati is deeply committed to mental health counseling and community-based living supports, which she incorporates into her mentorship approach. This holistic perspective not only nurtures the musicianship of her students but also promotes their overall well-being and independence. Through her innovative programming and compassionate guidance, Kati Strong is making a profound impact on the lives of young individuals at Tarrytown UMC, helping them to develop not just as musicians, but as confident, resilient members of their community.

About Texas A&M College of Dentistry
------------------------------------

Texas A&M College of Dentistry, located at 3302 Gaston Ave. in Dallas, Texas, has been a cornerstone of dental education for over a century. Established in 1905, the college has a rich history that includes affiliations with Baylor University and a significant transition to becoming part of The Texas A&M University System in 1996. As a founding college of the Texas A&M Health Science Center in 1999, it has continued to uphold its commitment to excellence in dental education, research, and community service. The college is renowned for producing highly skilled clinicians, with more than half of the dentists practicing in the Dallas/Fort Worth area and nearly one-third of all dentists in Texas being alumni.  
  
The curriculum at Texas A&M College of Dentistry emphasizes hands-on learning through diverse patient interactions, equipping students with the practical skills and life lessons necessary for their future careers. The college also leads the state in graduating dental hygienists with bachelor's degrees, further solidifying its reputation as a premier institution for dental education. In addition to its Doctor of Dental Surgery (DDS) program, the college offers a variety of postdoctoral certificate and degree programs, providing graduates with valuable post-graduate experiences prior to licensure.  
  
For those interested in the faculty that shapes the future of dental professionals, the Texas A&M College of Dentistry teachers list showcases a dedicated team of educators and researchers committed to student success and innovation in the field. With a legacy of over 8,000 graduates, the college continues to be a vital resource for aspiring dental professionals in Texas and beyond.

About Swami Mukundananda

Swami Mukundananda, as the Founder of JKYog US, plays a pivotal role in promoting holistic health and spiritual well-being through a multifaceted approach that integrates yoga, meditation, and mind management. His extensive expertise in these areas has made him a sought-after authority, inspiring millions of seekers worldwide. Under his guidance, JKYog has embarked on significant initiatives that aim to enhance the physical, mental, intellectual, and spiritual well-being of individuals.  
  
Among these initiatives are the Jagadguru Kripalu University (JKU), which focuses on higher education rooted in spiritual wisdom, and the Jagadguru Kripalu Yoga and Naturopathy Hospital and Research Center (JKYNHRC), which emphasizes the healing power of natural therapies and yoga. Additionally, the Jagadguru Kripalu Chikitsalay (JKC) serves as a center for holistic treatments, blending traditional wisdom with modern health practices.  
  
Swami Mukundananda’s work transcends conventional boundaries, as he combines his skills in public speaking, lifestyle coaching, and stress management to deliver transformative programs that resonate with diverse audiences. His best-selling books delve into the esoteric aspects of meditation and mind management, providing practical tools for stress relief and relaxation. Through workshops, retreats, and online courses, he continues to empower individuals to achieve a balanced lifestyle, fostering a deeper connection with themselves and the divine. In a world increasingly in need of holistic solutions, Swami Mukundananda stands as a beacon of hope and guidance, illuminating the path to God Realization and overall well-being.

About Jodoin Lamarre Pratte architectes
---------------------------------------

Jodoin Lamarre Pratte architectes consacre sa pratique à la réalisation de projets d’architecture au service de la collectivité, principalement dans les domaines institutionnels de la santé, du transport, de l’enseignement, de la recherche et de la culture. La firme œuvre à la conception d’une architecture humaine, sensible, intelligente et respectueuse de son environnement, alliant créativité, connaissances et innovation. Elle valorise la diversité et la complémentarité des compétences et des expertises des membres de sa grande équipe et perpétue une culture de collaboration, d'inclusion, d'intégrité et de rigueur.  
  
C’est dans cet esprit que la firme travaille avec ses clients et partenaires à la création de bâtiments durables. La durabilité se manifeste de façon holistique dans tous les aspects de sa pratique et dans la conception de ses projets, qu’il s’agisse de la flexibilité des usages, de la pérennité des systèmes, de la performance énergétique globale, de l’empreinte écologique des matériaux, de la qualité des milieux de vie, de l’intégration du bâti à son environnement ou de la résilience face aux changements climatiques.  
  
Récipiendaire de plus de 165 prix d’excellence et distinctions en architecture, la firme a démontré à de nombreuses reprises sa capacité à concevoir et à réaliser des projets d’une grande qualité architecturale. Fondée en 1958 par Bernard Jodoin, Denis Lamarre et Gérard Pratte, Jodoin Lamarre Pratte architectes regroupe aujourd’hui une équipe de 125 architectes, technologues, techniciens, designers et autres professionnels sous la direction de Julie Boucher, Michel Broz, Catherine Demers, Martine Gévry, Sylvain Morrier et Nicolas Ranger.

About Emission Resource Group, LLC
----------------------------------

“Our Mission is to be the leading global innovator, developer and provider of efficient and environmentally sound energy production, and evolve as a major contributor to national as well as global efforts for both energy independence and environmental protection.”  
  
Emission Resource Group’s (ERG) primary focus over the last three decades has been the research and design of “green” technologies in the reclamation of solid municipal waste (WTE) industry. Receiving global recognition as an industry leader in safe environmentally friendly “Green” renewable energy, ERG’s patented technology has revolutionized the market and has quickly become the industry standard for the gasification process.  
  
Although ERG continues to operate this segment of business, ERG has transitioned to focus on the manufacturing and installation of our state of the art WTE systems. ERG’s WTE power plants are a combination of sub-component systems designed for “Green” gasification. These systems in conjunction with ERG’s patented MicroMist Scrubber technology virtually eliminates all harmful emissions/dioxins released to the atmosphere through WTE exhaust. ERG’s WTE facilities deliver clean, renewable electric power to major utilities for distribution to hundreds of thousands of homes and businesses globally.

Her strategic vision and hands-on approach to retail management not only drive sales but also cultivate a strong team culture that prioritizes customer satisfaction. About The Air Force School (TAFS), Subroto Park
-----------------------------------------------

The Air Force School (TAFS), located in the serene surroundings of Subroto Park, New Delhi, has been a beacon of quality education since its inception on July 18, 1955. Initially established in temporary wartime hutments at Wellingdon Camp, the school moved to its picturesque Aravali Campus in 1967, where it now occupies a sprawling 15-acre area adorned with majestic Eucalyptus and Ashoka trees, alongside vibrant Bougainvillea blooms. TAFS was founded primarily to cater to the educational needs of children belonging to Indian Air Force personnel, but it has always welcomed wards of Army and Navy personnel, as well as civilian students, thereby fostering a diverse learning environment.  
  
As a co-educational public school affiliated with the Central Board of Secondary Education (CBSE), TAFS offers a comprehensive curriculum from classes VI to XII, including boarding facilities for boys. The school is recognized for its commitment to modern education and has been an ISO-certified institution since 2007. TAFS is also a proud member of the National Progressive Schools Conference (NPSC), reflecting its dedication to progressive educational practices.  
  
For parents seeking information about the faculty, the Air Force School (TAFS), Subroto Park teachers list is available on their official website, providing insights into the experienced and qualified educators dedicated to nurturing the next generation. With a focus on holistic development, TAFS continues to uphold its mission of delivering quality education while creating a supportive and inclusive community for all its students.

About Association of Licensed Architects Minnesota
--------------------------------------------------

The Association of Licensed Architects Minnesota | ALAMN is a chapter of the ALA national non profit professional organization. ALA Minnesota is open to all architects and professions related to architecture. We were founded in 1999 at the same time as the national organization. Our territory covers all of Minnesota, Western Wisconsin, Northern Iowa and the Eastern Dakotas. Our members include architects, interns, students, retired architects, and industry professionals.  
  
ALA was founded in 1999 by architects who previously served as Board Members of other architects’ associations. Shortly thereafter the Illinois Society of Architects (ISA), the oldest independent state organization in the country, combined efforts with ALA, bringing respected expertise and historic significance to the Association. Representatives from Minnesota have served on the national board since its inception.  
  
Our founders formed ALA and ALAMN in order to provide value to architects. Affordable products and services that enable architects stay current with industry best practices, maintain their licenses, and provide quality service to the public. That philosophy remains the driving force behind ALA today.  
  
Commitment of service to help our members achieve their goals has been a major factor in the Association’s rapid growth. ALA now has members across the United States and in foreign countries.

About David Kranz

David Christian Kranz is a seasoned executive and partner with over 30 years of comprehensive experience in the Apparel & Fashion Industry, currently serving as the Owner and Chief Merchandising Officer at Swet Tailor. His extensive background spans all facets of the industry, including sales, merchandising, design, production, sourcing, private label, brand management, and buying. David has a proven track record of driving sales growth and profitability while effectively managing, mentoring, and coaching hundreds of direct reports, showcasing his leadership acumen.  
  
At Swet Tailor, David has successfully created a direct-to-consumer (DTC) brand that emphasizes modern styles designed for everyday wear, utilizing innovative fabrics that are not only incredibly soft to the touch but also offer stretch for enhanced comfort. Under his leadership, the brand has expanded its DTC presence into over 100 wholesale boutiques, including prestigious retailers such as Bloomingdale's, Nordstrom, and Dick’s Sporting Goods. Additionally, David has spearheaded the launch of the Pro Shop Golf business, strategically placing products in golf country clubs, events, and hotel resorts nationwide, thereby tapping into a lucrative market segment.  
  
David's expertise in trend analysis and global sourcing, combined with his skills in visual merchandising and assortment planning, enables him to stay ahead of industry trends and consumer preferences. His ability to navigate the complexities of multi-channel retail ensures that Swet Tailor remains competitive and relevant in a rapidly evolving marketplace. With a commitment to excellence and a passion for fashion, David continues to drive innovation and growth at Swet Tailor, solidifying the brand's position as a leader in the modern apparel landscape.

Who We Are  
ClimaTrends is a collaboration of sustainability, meteorology, business & climate science experts, leveraging innovative approaches to better understand, analyze and communicate future physical and transitional climate risks and opportunities for businesses and communities.  
  
How We Work  
We work collaboratively with clients to pursue transformative relationships, as opposed to transactional relationships. We bring a spirit of inquiry, learning and humility to the work of building our business’ capacity for excellence in our field. Our work is aspirational, yet we remain grounded in rigorous and practical business principles.  
  
What We Create  
We create a platform for organizations and communities to better understand future climate risks and assess, modify and implement strategies for adaptation and resilience. We facilitate the process of clarifying and communicating climate related risks and opportunities.  
  
What We Leave Behind  
We exemplify an innovative approach to future climate modeling, to set more accurate expectations of physical and transitional risks for human systems worldwide. ClimaTrends aims to leave behind a world with more stable, resilient and adaptable organizations and communities.  
  
Climate Scenario Analysis  
Scenario analysis is an essential tool for understanding the implications of climate change on business. Conducting a climate scenario analysis is a critical step to TCFD reporting. With deep expertise in climate, weather and corporate sustainability, ClimaTrends helps build a comprehensive climate scenario analysis uniquely tailored to your business.

About Telemundo Houston | KTMD

About Telemundo Houston / KTMD  
Telemundo Houston / KTMD is Telemundo’s local television station serving Spanish-speaking viewers in Houston, the fourth largest Hispanic television market in the country. Telemundo Houston aired the market’s first-ever Spanish-language television newscast more than 30 years ago. Owned by NBCUniversal, today, the station locally produces approximately 17 hours of news and information programming each week and delivers viewers the most up-to-date local news, weather forecasts and sports and entertainment headlines across all platforms, including online at TelemundoHouston.com, via its dedicated mobile app and through its social media channels. (Facebook: TelemundoHouston /

Viewers can find Telemundo Houston on local channels Xfinity 6 or 606 in HD, Dish and DirectTV 47 and over the air 47.1.

About UNH Institute on Disability
---------------------------------

The UNH Institute on Disability (IOD), established in 1987, serves as a pivotal resource for enhancing the lives of individuals with disabilities and their families. As New Hampshire’s University Center for Excellence in Disability (UCED), the IOD is situated within the University of New Hampshire and operates under the auspices of the federally designated Developmental Disabilities Act. The Institute is dedicated to advancing knowledge, policies, and practices that foster inclusivity and improve the quality of life for people with disabilities. Through a blend of innovative research, interdisciplinary collaboration, and community engagement, the IOD builds essential capacities at local, state, and national levels.  
  
The IOD's initiatives encompass a wide range of academic and service programs aimed at addressing the unique challenges faced by individuals with disabilities. By focusing on evidence-based practices and promoting inclusive education, the Institute plays a crucial role in shaping a more equitable society. For educators and professionals seeking to enhance their understanding of disability issues, the UNH Institute on Disability provides valuable resources, including a comprehensive teachers list that highlights experts in the field. This list serves as a vital tool for those looking to connect with knowledgeable practitioners and researchers dedicated to improving educational outcomes for students with disabilities. Overall, the IOD stands as a beacon of hope and progress, championing the rights and opportunities of individuals with disabilities across the nation.

What is Dremio and how does it differ from traditional data warehouses?

Dremio is an open-source data lakehouse platform that combines the flexibility of a data lake with the performance of a data warehouse. This self-service analytics capability enables organizations to access and analyze their data without the need for extensive ETL processes, reducing time to insights.

What types of data sources can Dremio connect to?

With features like data reflections, which optimize query performance, and support for SQL, Dremio enables faster and more efficient reporting and visualization in popular BI tools such as Tableau, Power BI, and Looker.

Is Dremio suitable for organizations with limited data engineering resources?

Absolutely! Dremio is designed for self-service analytics, allowing business users to explore and analyze data without heavy reliance on data engineering teams. Its intuitive interface and powerful features enable users to create datasets, perform transformations, and run queries with minimal technical expertise. This empowers organizations with limited resources to make data-driven decisions quickly and effectively.

Based in colorful Colorado, dVault Company has a 150,000 square foot manufacturing facility, so all dVault products are 100% made in the USA. Because of our location, we have a major advantage when shipping our products around the country.

His ability to analyze complex logistics challenges and develop innovative solutions has positioned him as a pivotal figure in Serta Simmons Bedding's commitment to excellence in logistics management. Founded in 1986, MPLC provides copyright compliance solutions that allow businesses, governmental departments, and other organizations to show content in public simply and affordably. To that end, fees from every public performance license we issue are shared with our rights holders, supporting the next generation of content we love to watch.  
  
MPLC licenses hundreds of thousands of locations in more than 40 countries around the world. Our license covers public performances from broadcast, cable, and satellite television; DVDs and Blu-ray; downloads and streaming services. From our renowned Umbrella License®, to title-by-title and digital licenses offered around the world, we offer the public performance licensing solutions you need to ensure copyright compliance.  
  
Our passion is twofold: provide organizations with an affordable way to watch content in public and pay royalties to the artists and rights holders responsible for the content we love.

### Frequently Asked Questions about Motion Picture Licensing Corporation

Who are the decision makers in Motion Picture Licensing Corporation?

The decision makers in Motion Picture Licensing Corporation are [Andrew Harwood](https://contactout.com/andrew-harwood-31658)

.

What is a public performance license and why do I need one?

A public performance license is a legal authorization that allows businesses, organizations, and individuals to show movies, television shows, and other audiovisual works in public settings. This license is necessary because copyright laws grant content creators exclusive rights to control how their works are distributed and displayed. Without this license, you risk facing legal consequences, including fines or lawsuits, for unauthorized public screenings.

What types of venues or events require a public performance license?

Public performance licenses are required for a wide range of venues and events, including but not limited to: schools, universities, hotels, restaurants, bars, gyms, community centers, and outdoor events. Essentially, any situation where a film or television show is shown to an audience outside of a private home necessitates a public performance license.

How does MPLC assist with copyright compliance for public performances?

The Motion Picture Licensing Corporation (MPLC) provides comprehensive licensing solutions that help organizations comply with copyright laws when showing films and television programs. MPLC offers a variety of licensing options, including blanket licenses that cover a wide range of titles, as well as title-by-title licensing for specific works. This flexibility allows clients to choose the best option for their needs while ensuring they are legally protected.

What industries does MPLC serve?

MPLC serves a diverse range of industries, including education, hospitality, healthcare, fitness, and corporate sectors. Whether it's a school screening, a movie night at a hotel, or a training session featuring film clips, MPLC provides licensing solutions tailored to the unique needs of each industry, ensuring compliance with copyright regulations.

Can I show movies for free in my business without a license?

No, showing movies for free in a public setting still requires a public performance license. Even if you are not charging an admission fee, copyright laws still apply, and you must obtain the appropriate license to avoid potential legal issues. MPLC can help you navigate these requirements and secure the necessary licenses.

How can I obtain a public performance license through MPLC?

Obtaining a public performance license through MPLC is a straightforward process. You can visit the MPLC website to explore the different licensing options available. Once you select the appropriate license for your needs, you can complete the application online or contact MPLC's customer service for assistance. They will guide you through the process and ensure you have the necessary permissions to legally show films and television programs.

About Panjab Radio
------------------

Panjab Radio, headquartered on Springfield Road in Hayes, Middlesex, has been a cornerstone of the Punjabi community in Europe since its inception on September 1, 2000. As the world's first 100% Punjabi radio station, it plays a vital role in connecting and celebrating the rich cultural heritage of Punjabis from both India and Pakistan. With 72% of the Asian community speaking and understanding Punjabi, the station caters to a significant demographic, making Punjabi the second most spoken language in England.  
  
Panjab Radio offers a diverse range of programming that includes music, news, talk shows, and cultural discussions, all delivered in Punjabi. This unique blend of content not only entertains but also informs and engages listeners about current events, community issues, and cultural celebrations. The station utilizes cutting-edge broadcasting technologies to ensure high-quality audio and a seamless listening experience, whether through traditional FM radio or online streaming via its website.  
  
In addition to its radio broadcasts, Panjab Radio actively engages with its audience through social media platforms, fostering a sense of community and providing a space for dialogue among listeners. By serving the Punjabi diaspora, Panjab Radio has become an essential platform for cultural expression, promoting Punjabi language and traditions while also addressing the needs and interests of its audience. Through its commitment to quality content and community engagement, Panjab Radio continues to be a beacon for Punjabis in Europe and beyond.

------------

Arhaus was founded in 1986 on a simple idea: Furniture and décor should be sustainably sourced, lovingly made, and built to last. Today, we partner with artisans around the world who share our vision, creating beautiful, heirloom-quality pieces that can be used - and loved - for generations.  
  
Our Commitment to the Earth - Through our Green Initiative, our artisan partners use sustainably sourced, reclaimed, and recycled materials as much as possible. From harvesting wood from mango trees that no longer produce fruit, to repurposing recycled copper, we take pride in giving new life to what would otherwise be discarded.  
  
Our Artisan Partners - We travel the globe, seeking out talented artisans whose time-honored techniques create beautifully unique, handcrafted works of art. From rug weavers in India to upholstery workshops in North Carolina, to families of master woodworkers in Italy and Mexico, our artisan partnerships span continents and generations.  
  
Our Pledge for Inclusion - We save a seat at the table for everyone, because we know with absolute certainty that diversity is what makes the world a beautiful, interesting place to live. Regardless of race, age, gender, or background - all are welcome here.  
  
Our Promise to the World - Giving back to our communities near and far has been at the heart if our mission since day 1. Today, we support a variety of organizations that share our vision for caring for the environment and improving the lives of those in need, including Habitat for Humanity, American Forests, Global Dental Relief, and the Small World.

About Think Creative
--------------------

At Think Creative, we develop innovative products, services, and brand extensions to help businesses increase sustainable top-line growth.  
  
Growth Opportunity Detection: We employ unique consumer insight strategies to gather an in-depth understanding of their needs and desires. By analyzing the market’s ability to satisfy those demands (including our clients’), we identify attractive market gaps prime for capitalization.  
  
Brand Extension/New Business: New revenue opportunities often lie in market categories adjacent to your core business. We help you seize them, generating a business model that’s profitable and practical, which your company is already prepared to execute.  
  
New Product and Services: We develop unique solutions to capitalize on market gaps. We explore every option, from adding features to your current products and services to expanding your portfolio with new ones. With a growth direction chosen, our creative and design teams create the product or service, while our market and finance teams check its economic feasibility.  
  
Branding and Packaging: Even the best products still need great branding and packaging design to compete. After developing the product’s branding and packaging design guidelines, we call in the design hot shots from our sister company Imagemme.  
  
Innovation Seeding: You don’t want to hire consultants every time you want to update your products and services. We can help you keep this work in-house by transferring our innovation skills to your team, and then creating processes tailored to your organizational structure.

Chameleon Communications International provides a wide range of services tailored to the medical communications field. Their diverse offerings are designed to meet the needs of pharmaceutical and biotechnology companies, ensuring effective communication and education in the medical community.

How does Chameleon ensure the quality of its medical education programs?

Throughout the process, they ensure alignment with regulatory requirements and industry standards to deliver a robust scientific platform.

How does Chameleon support the training of Medical Science Liaisons (MSLs)?

Chameleon Communications International offers specialized MSL training programs designed to equip Medical Science Liaisons with the necessary skills and knowledge to effectively engage with healthcare professionals. Their training covers a range of topics, including scientific communication, therapeutic area expertise, and stakeholder engagement strategies. The programs are tailored to meet the specific needs of the client’s organization and are delivered through interactive workshops, role-playing scenarios, and real-world case studies, ensuring that MSLs are well-prepared to fulfill their roles.

Texas A&M boasts a strong military tradition, having contributed men and women in uniform to every armed conflict since the Spanish-American War. Student-athletes represent Texas A&M across 18 sports within the Southeastern Conference. Additionally, the George H.W. Quick to offer a cheery "Howdy!" to any visitor, Aggies pride themselves on their hospitality and strive to live out the University's core values of respect, excellence, leadership, loyalty, integrity, and selfless service.

PeaceHealth, based in Vancouver, Wash., is a not-for-profit Catholic health system offering care to communities in Washington, Oregon and Alaska. PeaceHealth has approximately 16,000 caregivers, a medical group practice with more than 900 providers and 10 medical centers serving both urban and rural communities throughout the Northwest. In 1890, the Sisters of St. Joseph of Peace founded what has become PeaceHealth. The Sisters shared expertise and transferred wisdom from one medical center to another, always finding the best way to serve the unmet need for healthcare in their communities. Today, PeaceHealth is the legacy of the founding Sisters and continues with a spirit of respect, stewardship, collaboration and social justice in fulfilling its Mission. About Idaho National Laboratory
-------------------------------

In operation since 1949, Idaho National Laboratory is a science-based, applied engineering national laboratory dedicated to supporting the U.S. Department of Energy's missions in energy research, nuclear science and national defense. The world's first usable amount of electricity from nuclear energy was generated here in 1951.  
  
At 890 square miles (569,135 acres), the INL Site is roughly 85 percent the size of Rhode Island. In addition to our geographic resources, the lab hosts a variety of unique facilities, including the Advanced Test Reactor National Scientific User Facility.  
  
Complementing our nuclear research, the lab has numerous alternative energy and national security programs. Robotics, wind power, high-performance computing, biofuels, critical infrastructure protection, carbon management and advanced vehicle testing are just a few examples of our multifaceted research capabilities. If you are looking for a 21st-century energy or technology career, visit our Careers tab at www.inl.gov.

About Perspectives Charter Schools
----------------------------------

Perspectives Charter Schools is a network of five open-enrollment middle and high schools committed to teaching a rigorous college-prep curriculum.  
  
At Perspectives, we educate the student beyond the classroom to succeed in college and in life while empowering our teachers through a unique education model.  
  
Perspectives'​ award-winning teachers have received countless accolades, including the Shell Urban Science Educator Award, presented by the National Science Teacher's Association. We support our teachers with the opportunity to grow through training and professional development to complement their career goals.  
  
Our education model — A Disciplined Life® (ADL) — has a curriculum that focuses on social-emotional learning, academia, and character building. Using this model, our teachers guide student behavior and performance, helping them to develop positive self-perception, healthy relationships, and the tools for productivity.  
  
The ADL model produces impressive results with 92% college acceptance rate, students earning over $20 Million in scholarships annually, and persisting in college at rates above the national average. All five of Perspectives Charter Schools earned level 1/1+ rankings from Chicago Public Schools. These are the highest possible rankings — made possible by Perspectives'​ committed and talented staff.  
  
To learn more about Perspectives and our current open positions, visit www.pcsedu.org.
