About Hobby Lobby
-----------------

Hobby Lobby Stores, Inc., founded in 1972 by David and Barbara Green, has grown from a small garage operation into one of America's leading retailers in the arts and crafts industry. Headquartered in Oklahoma City, Oklahoma, Hobby Lobby operates over 900 stores nationwide, each averaging 55,000 square feet of retail space. The company offers an extensive selection of more than 70,000 products, including arts and crafts supplies, home décor, seasonal items, and holiday decorations, catering to a diverse customer base passionate about creativity and DIY projects.  
  
As a privately held company, Hobby Lobby is recognized on Forbes' annual list of America's largest private companies and is notable for its financial stability, operating without long-term debt. The company prides itself on fostering a positive work environment, promoting from within, and providing opportunities for career advancement, particularly in retail management roles. Hobby Lobby's commitment to its employees is reflected in its dedication to creating a workplace that nurtures character and family values, all while honoring its Christian principles.  
  
With a focus on customer satisfaction, Hobby Lobby employs a "Super Savings & Super Selection®" strategy, ensuring that shoppers find everything they need to "Live a Creative Life®." The company operates Monday through Saturday from 9 a.m. to 8 p.m., remaining closed on Sundays to honor its values. Through its innovative approach and commitment to quality, Hobby Lobby continues to inspire creativity and craftsmanship across the nation. For more information, visit their website at http://www.hobbylobby.com.

About True Fit Corporation
--------------------------

True Fit is the industry's leading consumer experience platform leveraged by apparel and footwear retailers to decode fit and size and connect shoppers with only what they love. It has organized and connected the broadest footwear, apparel and consumer data in the world to provide best in class fit recommendations covering the industry’s brands and styles. The platform unites social, general and personalized fit guidance into one cohesive experience, driving shopper confidence and loyalty.  
  
Through serving shoppers across its network of retailers’ websites, True Fit delivers rich datasets back to retailers to inform their strategies and initiatives - from marketing and merchandising to sourcing and product development. These data sets serve a tremendous need in today’s shifting market - who is this new shopper and how can they be met with relevance?  
  
True Fit is led by an experienced team of executives and leaders from fashion, retail, big data and ecommerce, and is backed by top investors.  
  
Follow @truefit on Facebook and Twitter and @findyourtruefit Instagram.

About Makena Capital Management, LLC
------------------------------------

Makena Capital Management, LLC was formed in 2005 by senior executives from the Stanford Management Company and leading practitioners from elite North American endowments and foundations. We provide investment expertise, scale, and premier investment access to our client base of multigenerational pools of capital, including endowments, foundations, family offices, pensions and sovereign wealth funds. Alternative and private asset investing lies at the core of our investment process; we believe alternative and private assets play a key role in preserving and growing capital over a long time horizon by diversifying risk and return streams. We offer access to these selective investment opportunities through our discretionary, commingled vehicles: a multi-asset class, endowment portfolio, and single-asset class portfolios providing targeted exposure designed to complement a broad portfolio. Based in the heart of Silicon Valley in Menlo Park, California, our nearly 75-person team is solely focused on providing superior risk-adjusted returns and world class service to our clients.

### Frequently Asked Questions about Apollo Solutions Group

What types of energy efficiency solutions does Apollo Solutions Group offer?

Apollo Solutions Group specializes in a variety of energy efficiency solutions, including energy audits, retrofitting existing systems, and implementing advanced building technologies. Our services are designed to optimize energy consumption, reduce operational costs, and enhance the overall sustainability of your building. We work closely with clients to tailor solutions that meet their specific needs and objectives.

How does Apollo Solutions Group ensure guaranteed outcomes for their resource efficiency solutions?

At Apollo Solutions Group, we are committed to delivering guaranteed outcomes through our comprehensive approach to resource efficiency. We utilize data-driven methodologies and advanced analytics to assess current building performance and identify opportunities for improvement. Our team then implements customized solutions that are rigorously monitored and evaluated to ensure they meet the agreed-upon performance metrics, providing clients with peace of mind and measurable results.

Can Apollo Solutions Group assist with facility improvement measures for existing buildings?

Yes, Apollo Solutions Group offers a range of facility improvement measures for existing buildings. Our services include upgrading HVAC systems, enhancing insulation, implementing smart building technologies, and optimizing lighting systems. We focus on improving the operational efficiency of your facility while also addressing comfort and safety for occupants. Our team conducts thorough assessments to identify the best improvement strategies tailored to your building's unique requirements.

What industries does Apollo Solutions Group serve?

Apollo Solutions Group serves a diverse range of industries, including commercial real estate, healthcare, education, hospitality, and government facilities. Our expertise in resource efficiency solutions allows us to address the specific challenges and regulatory requirements of each sector. We are dedicated to helping organizations across various industries achieve their sustainability goals while improving their financial performance.

What is a turn-key resource efficiency solution, and how does it benefit clients?

A turn-key resource efficiency solution provided by Apollo Solutions Group encompasses the entire process of identifying, designing, implementing, and managing energy efficiency projects. This approach allows clients to have a single point of contact for all aspects of the project, simplifying the management process. Benefits include reduced project timelines, minimized disruptions during implementation, and the assurance that the project will meet performance guarantees, ultimately leading to lower operational costs and enhanced sustainability.

How can I get started with Apollo Solutions Group's services?

Getting started with Apollo Solutions Group is simple. You can visit our website at http://www.apollosolutionsgroup.com to learn more about our services and solutions. If you're ready to discuss your specific needs, you can fill out our contact form or call our office directly. Our team will schedule an initial consultation to assess your requirements and outline how we can help you achieve your resource efficiency goals.

What types of cyber security solutions does Sysnet Global Solutions offer?

Sysnet Global Solutions provides a comprehensive range of cyber security solutions designed to help businesses protect their sensitive data and maintain compliance with industry standards. Our offerings include penetration testing, information security assurance, and compliance services for PCI DSS, ISO 27001, and GDPR. We also provide tailored solutions to address specific security needs, ensuring that our clients can effectively mitigate risks and safeguard their operations.

How does Sysnet Global Solutions assist businesses with PCI compliance?

Sysnet Global Solutions specializes in helping businesses achieve and maintain PCI compliance through a variety of services. We offer PCI DSS assessments, gap analysis, and remediation support to identify and address vulnerabilities. Our team of experts provides guidance on best practices for securing payment card data and helps organizations implement the necessary controls to comply with PCI standards, ensuring they can process transactions securely and protect customer information.

What industries does Sysnet Global Solutions serve?

Sysnet Global Solutions serves a diverse range of industries that require robust cyber security and compliance solutions. Our clients include businesses in retail, hospitality, e-commerce, financial services, and healthcare, among others. We understand the unique challenges faced by each industry and tailor our services to meet their specific regulatory requirements and security needs, helping them to thrive in a secure environment.

Can Sysnet Global Solutions help with GDPR compliance?

Yes, Sysnet Global Solutions offers services to assist organizations in achieving compliance with the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR). Our team provides GDPR assessments, data protection impact assessments (DPIAs), and guidance on implementing necessary policies and procedures. We help businesses understand their obligations under GDPR, ensuring they handle personal data responsibly and protect the privacy rights of individuals.

What is penetration testing and how can it benefit my organization?

Penetration testing is a simulated cyber attack conducted by security professionals to identify vulnerabilities in an organization's systems, networks, and applications. Sysnet Global Solutions offers comprehensive penetration testing services that help organizations uncover weaknesses before they can be exploited by malicious actors. By identifying and addressing these vulnerabilities, businesses can strengthen their security posture, protect sensitive data, and comply with industry regulations.

How does Sysnet Global Solutions ensure ongoing support for its clients?

Sysnet Global Solutions is committed to providing extraordinary services and support to our clients. We offer ongoing assistance through dedicated account management, regular security assessments, and updates on compliance requirements. Our team of experts is available to answer questions, provide training, and offer guidance on best practices, ensuring that our clients remain secure and compliant in an ever-evolving cyber threat landscape.

His expertise in stage management and orchestral music ensures that each event is meticulously planned and executed, while his background in musical theatre and jazz enriches the artistic offerings of the organization.  
  
In addition to his performance work, Eric is passionate about providing voice lessons and mentorship to aspiring artists, fostering the next generation of talent in the performing arts. His commitment to excellence and creativity has made Opera Cowboy Presents a beacon for artistic expression, where the boundaries of classical music are continually redefined. About Adele Cash

Adele Cash is an established fashion designer known for her elegant and sophisticated designs that blend classic styles with modern trends. With a keen eye for detail and a passion for creating timeless pieces, Adele has made a name for herself in the world of fashion. Her designs are characterized by luxurious fabrics, impeccable tailoring, and a focus on creating garments that exude confidence and grace.  
  
Adele's journey in the fashion industry began at a young age, as she discovered her love for sewing and design while watching her grandmother create beautiful garments. This early exposure ignited a passion within her, and she went on to study fashion design at a prestigious university, honing her skills and refining her craft. After graduating, she worked for several renowned fashion houses, where she gained invaluable experience and knowledge of the industry before eventually launching her own label, Adele Cash.  
  
What sets Adele's designs apart is her commitment to creating pieces that not only look stunning but also make the wearer feel empowered and beautiful. She believes that fashion should be a reflection of one's individuality and personality, and her designs are created with this philosophy in mind. From tailored suiting to flowing evening gowns, each piece in Adele's collection is meticulously designed to flatter the body and elevate the wearer's confidence.  
  
One of the key elements of Adele's design process is her dedication to using the finest materials and craftsmanship. She sources luxurious fabrics from around the globe, ensuring that each garment not only looks exquisite but also feels luxurious to wear. Whether it's silk, cashmere, or fine wool, Adele prioritizes quality in every aspect of her designs. Additionally, her attention to detail in tailoring and construction results in garments that are not only visually stunning but also impeccably made.  
  
Adele's designs have garnered attention from fashion enthusiasts and celebrities alike, with her pieces being worn on red carpets and at high-profile events. Her clientele includes influential women who appreciate the artistry and elegance of her designs, as well as the attention to detail and quality that goes into each piece. From her timeless cocktail dresses to her statement-making outerwear, Adele's brand has become synonymous with sophistication and refinement.  
  
In addition to her ready-to-wear collections, Adele also offers bespoke services for clients seeking one-of-a-kind pieces that are tailored to their specific preferences and measurements. This personalized approach to design allows her to create truly unique garments that are a true reflection of the wearer's style and personality. Whether it's a custom gown for a special occasion or a perfectly fitted suit for everyday wear, Adele's bespoke creations are a testament to her dedication to creating fashion that is both individualized and exquisite.  
  
Adele's impact on the fashion industry extends beyond her design work, as she is also passionate about giving back to her community and supporting emerging talent. She frequently mentors aspiring designers and collaborates with local artisans to showcase their work in her collections. Additionally, she is an advocate for sustainable and ethical fashion practices, making conscious choices in her production processes to minimize the environmental impact of her brand.  
  
Overall, Adele Cash is a designer whose passion for creating beautiful, empowering fashion has made her a respected figure in the industry. Her dedication to craftsmanship, quality, and individuality is evident in every piece she creates, and her timeless designs continue to captivate women who appreciate elegance and sophistication. With a commitment to staying true to her design ethos and a vision for the future of her brand, Adele Cash is a force to be reckoned with in the world of fashion.

Best in Market Financials and Service Excellence

Clarity is a three (3) pronged pharmacy beneﬁt management strategy that Community Scripts executes on behalf of its clients.  
  
1\. Guarantees “best-in-market” ﬁnancials that empowers payors and health plans to control costs  
2\. Provides easy-to-understand contract terms and conditions that support low net cost savings  
3\. Delivers service excellence with unmatched ﬂexibility to meet the unique needs of members and plans

Who is the CEO of NHS National Services Scotland?

Who are the decision makers in NHS National Services Scotland?

.

What services does NHS National Services Scotland provide to support healthcare organizations?

NHS National Services Scotland offers a range of shared services designed to enhance the efficiency and effectiveness of NHS Boards and other healthcare organizations. These services include legal services, procurement support, IT consultancy, blood and tissue services, commissioning and facilities management, practitioner and counter-fraud services, as well as statistical analysis and public health advice. By providing these services, we aim to help organizations save money and improve patient care.

How does NHS National Services Scotland assist with procurement processes?

NHS National Services Scotland plays a crucial role in procurement by offering expert guidance and support to NHS Boards. We help streamline procurement processes, ensuring compliance with regulations while achieving cost savings. Our procurement services include sourcing products and services, negotiating contracts, and providing training to staff on best practices in procurement. This enables healthcare organizations to focus on delivering quality care while we handle the complexities of procurement.

Can NHS National Services Scotland provide statistical analysis for public health research?

Yes, NHS National Services Scotland offers statistical analysis and public health advice to support research and decision-making. Our team of experts utilizes robust statistical methods to analyze health data, providing insights that inform public health strategies and policies. We collaborate with various stakeholders to ensure that our analyses address the specific needs of healthcare organizations and contribute to improving health outcomes across Scotland.

What role does NHS National Services Scotland play in blood and tissue services?

NHS National Services Scotland is responsible for overseeing blood and tissue services in Scotland. We ensure the safe and efficient collection, testing, and distribution of blood and tissue products to NHS hospitals and clinics. Our services include managing blood donation programs, ensuring compliance with safety regulations, and providing training for healthcare professionals involved in handling these vital resources. Our goal is to ensure that patients receive the highest quality care through reliable access to blood and tissue products.

How does NHS National Services Scotland support counter-fraud initiatives within the NHS?

NHS National Services Scotland provides practitioner and counter-fraud services to help safeguard NHS resources. We work closely with NHS Boards to identify, investigate, and prevent fraudulent activities. Our team offers training, guidance, and tools to enhance fraud detection and reporting. By promoting a culture of integrity and accountability, we aim to protect public funds and ensure that resources are used effectively for patient care.

What IT consultancy services does NHS National Services Scotland offer?

NHS National Services Scotland offers IT consultancy services aimed at enhancing the technological capabilities of healthcare organizations. Our services include IT strategy development, system implementation, data management, and cybersecurity support. We work collaboratively with NHS Boards to assess their IT needs and provide tailored solutions that improve operational efficiency, enhance patient care, and ensure compliance with data protection regulations.

About Wolverine Sports
----------------------

In 1953, Don Canham, then University of Michigan Track Coach, was in Europe touring as the coach of an AAU team. In Finland, he saw a 16mm movie film formed into a "loop" so students could watch an athlete's technique over and over without touching or reversing the film. After securing the 1936 Olympic films, he made a set of 16 different loops of the great champions from those games and of others he had filmed in various countries. In three months, this set of films sold to thousands of coaches in the United States and Europe. With this accumulated capital from the original investment of $250, he filmed and produced over 20 different "loop" sets, from cheerleading to football. Thus Champions on Film, the first of five divisions of School-Tech, was born.  
  
In 1955, the company began to import stopwatches from Switzerland and to manufacture weighted ankle bands, weighted jackets, and training devices. Sales to coaches of all sports led him into manufacturing disposable side-line markers for football, hurdles for track, backstops for baseball, and today, over 200 items for sports and recreation. This company, Wolverine Sports, sold only to the retail market, with the largest sales to the educational field. However, requests from sporting goods dealers to see Wolverine products brought on a wholesale division called Olympia Sports , now serving over 5,000 sporting goods dealers. These products are manufactured and distributed from Ann Arbor, Michigan.

About Al-Khoei Foundation
-------------------------

The Al-Khoei Foundation is a non-profit organisation that comprises a series of charitable institutions in the UK, USA, Canada, France, Pakistan, India and Thailand.  
  
Founded in 1989 by His Eminence the late Imam Sayed Abulqasim Al-Khoei, the Foundation’s aim is to look after the welfare of the Muslim communities, and Shia Muslims in particular, and promote education, engage in dialogue, enhance religious understanding and provide aid and support to the needy.  
  
The Al-Khoei Foundation holds a General Consultative Status at the United Nations Economic and Social Council (UN ECOSOC), and runs several cultural and community centres, schools, semanries, libraries, a university and various other projects worldwide. Moreover, it is regularly consulted by governmental and non-governmental bodies on a number of issues such as community cohesion, faith matters and interfaith relations.  
  
The Al-Khoei Foundation is headquartered in London, UK.

About Poliform Australia
------------------------

Poliform was founded in 1970, evolving from an artisan business dating back to 1942. In 1996, the company introduced Varenna, its specialist kitchen division, producing highly sophisticated and elegant designs that complement Poliform’s functional and timeless furniture. Contributing to Poliform’s success has been collaborations with some of the world’s most innovative designers and architects, including Marcel Wanders, Carlo Colombo, Vincent Van Duysen, Paolo Piva, Paola Navone, Studio Kairos, Robert Barbieri and Robert Lazzeroni.  
  
Poliform in Australia  
Poliform launched in Sydney, Australia in 1996 and has since expanded, opening showrooms in Melbourne, Singapore, and in Kuala Lumpur.  
  
Poliform Australia represents some of Italy’s most respected furniture brands including Poliform, Arflex and Porada and lighting brands Pallucco Italia and Oluce.  
  
In the showrooms located throughout Australasia, the Poliform collection offers a complete home solution, including kitchens, wall-to-wall storage systems, wardrobes, walk-in wardrobes, side tables, beds, dining tables and chairs, sofas, lighting and occasional pieces.

The Museum of Science and Industry, Chicago is the largest and most interactive science museum in the Western Hemisphere. Chicago’s Museum of Science and Industry (MSI) exposes guests of all ages to awe-inspiring exhibitions that spark curiosity and bring science to life. MSI’s mission – to inspire the inventive genius in everyone – is realized through its world-class exhibitions and engaging guest experiences. The Museum of Science and Industry provides programs and experiences that deepen the engagement of students and teachers in science and science-related disciplines, with a vision to inspire and motivate our children to achieve their full potential in the fields of science, technology, engineering, art, and math.  
  
We offer a creative, collaborative, and innovative environment for our employees. Our employees get great perks such as: benefits starting day one of your employment, free admission to MSI for family and friends, free admission to other museums, free parking in MSI’s garage and more! If you are equally passionate about our vision and want to be surrounded by a team of dynamic, smart and innovative people, the Museum of Science and Industry is the right place for you!

Tommy Joyner, Co-Owner of MilkBoy, has established himself as a pivotal figure in the Philadelphia music scene, leveraging his extensive expertise in sound engineering and music production to elevate both the recording studio and live music venue. Under his leadership, MilkBoy Recording has transformed from a modest private studio into the premier recording facility in the region, attracting renowned artists such as James Taylor and fostering a vibrant community of musicians. Tommy’s proficiency in advanced mixing techniques, including stereo, 5.1, and 7.1 formats, positions him as a sought-after Pro Tools expert, ensuring that every project meets the highest standards of audio quality.  
  
In addition to his technical skills, Tommy is instrumental in the strategic business development of MilkBoy, overseeing the expansion into live music with the establishment of the MilkBoy venue in 2006. This venture not only showcases emerging talent but also enhances the cultural fabric of Philadelphia. His role encompasses a broad range of responsibilities, from creative direction and musical direction to deal negotiation and venue management, demonstrating his multifaceted approach to the music industry.  
  
Tommy’s entrepreneurial spirit is complemented by his adeptness in digital file management, foley, and ADR, allowing him to navigate the complexities of modern music production seamlessly. His commitment to fostering relationships through social networking and marketing initiatives has significantly contributed to MilkBoy's reputation as a hub for creativity and collaboration. With a passion for public speaking and 'zine editing, Tommy continues to inspire the next generation of artists, making MilkBoy not just a recording studio or venue, but a cornerstone of Philadelphia's vibrant music landscape.

The Human Rights Campaign serve as America's largest civil rights organization working to achieve lesbian, gay, bisexual, transgender and queer equality. By inspiring and engaging individuals and communities, HRC strives to end discrimination against LGBTQ people and realize a world that achieves fundamental fairness and equality for all. The Human Rights Campaign envisions a world where lesbian, gay, bisexual, transgender and queer people are ensured equality and embraced as full members of society at home, at work and in every community. The Human Rights Campaign and Human Rights Campaign Foundation exists to create a world where lesbian, gay, bisexual, transgender and queer (LGBTQ+) people in all of our intersecting identities realize systemic equality, equity and liberation in all aspects of life. We approach everything we do through a lens of inclusion and racial equity because our work cannot be completed until the most marginalized members of the LGBTQ+ community have achieved equality. Through the values we live day-to-day, our benefits package, as well as a hybrid work environment, we hope you will become a part of this movement. Are YOU ready to change the world? About Chad Hurley

Chad Hurley, the former CEO of YouTube, is a visionary entrepreneur who forever changed the landscape of online video sharing. With his ingenious creation alongside co-founders Steve Chen and Jawed Karim, YouTube became a global phenomenon, revolutionizing the way we consume and share content.  
  
Born on January 24, 1977, in Reading, Pennsylvania, Hurley's passion for technology and entrepreneurship emerged at an early age. He pursued graphic design and fine arts at Indiana University of Pennsylvania, where he further honed his creative skills. Hurley then ventured into the corporate world, working at PayPal, where he met Chen and Karim, who would become his lifelong collaborators.  
  
In 2005, Hurley and his partners revolutionized the internet by launching YouTube, a platform that empowered users to upload, share, and view videos with the world. This innovative concept quickly garnered millions of users and soon became a cultural phenomenon. YouTube's user-friendly interface and vast library of content made it the go-to platform for viral videos, music, short films, and much more.  
  
Under Hurley's leadership as CEO, YouTube experienced exponential growth, attracting millions of users and gaining the attention of industry giants. The company's meteoric rise eventually caught the eye of Google, which acquired YouTube in 2006 for an astounding $1.65 billion. This acquisition positioned YouTube as one of the most influential and disruptive platforms of the digital age.  
  
Hurley's ability to understand what users craved in the ever-evolving digital landscape played a pivotal role in YouTube's success. He recognized the value of user-generated content, creating an accessible space for anyone to express themselves and share their creativity with the world. This democratization of media fundamentally changed the entertainment industry, giving rise to countless careers and opportunities for content creators across the globe.  
  
Despite stepping down as CEO in 2010, Hurley's contributions to the world of digital media continue to shape the way we consume and interact with content. After leaving YouTube, he ventured into new ventures, including AVOS Systems and MixBit. AVOS Systems aimed to revolutionize the social bookmarking sphere, while MixBit sought to disrupt the mobile video editing landscape.  
  
Beyond his professional endeavors, Hurley has shown a commitment to philanthropy, partnering with organizations such as the United Nations and Climate Reality to address global issues. He has also spearheaded initiatives to promote science, technology, engineering, and mathematics (STEM) education, recognizing the importance of inspiring future generations in this rapidly advancing digital age.  
  
Chad Hurley's journey from a small town in Pennsylvania to becoming the CEO of YouTube is a testament to his creativity, business acumen, and relentless pursuit of innovation. His visionary leadership transformed YouTube into a household name, creating a platform that revolutionized the way we create, consume, and share content. As the digital landscape continues to evolve, Hurley's impact will forever be etched in the annals of internet history, inspiring countless entrepreneurs and content creators to follow in his footsteps.

About Africa Rice Center
------------------------

AfricaRice is a CGIAR Research Center – part of a global research partnership for a food-secure future. It is also an intergovernmental association of African member countries.  
  
The Center was created in 1971 by 11 African countries. Today its membership comprises 27 countries, covering West, Central, East and North African regions, namely Benin, Burkina Faso, Cameroon, Central African Republic, Chad, Côte d’Ivoire, Democratic Republic of Congo, Egypt, Ethiopia, Gabon, the Gambia, Ghana, Guinea, Guinea Bissau, Liberia, Madagascar, Mali, Mauritania, Mozambique, Niger, Nigeria, Republic of Congo, Rwanda, Senegal, Sierra Leone, Togo and Uganda.  
  
AfricaRice headquarters is based in Côte d’Ivoire. Staff are located in Côte d’Ivoire and also in AfricaRice Research Stations in Benin, Liberia, Madagascar, Nigeria, and Senegal.  
  
For more information visit: www.AfricaRice.org

How can I contact AfricaRice for inquiries related to research and services?

You can reach AfricaRice by visiting the 'Contact Us' section on our website, where you'll find email addresses and phone numbers for various departments. For specific research inquiries, please direct your questions to the relevant research team listed in our staff directory.

Is there a staff directory available for AfricaRice?

Yes, AfricaRice provides a staff directory on our website. You can find contact information and areas of expertise for our researchers and administrative staff, which can help you connect with the right person for your specific needs or inquiries.

What types of services does AfricaRice offer to its member countries?

AfricaRice offers a range of services including research and development in rice production, capacity building, and policy support. We aim to enhance food security and improve livelihoods through sustainable agricultural practices tailored to the needs of our member countries.

How can I collaborate with AfricaRice on agricultural research?

To explore collaboration opportunities with AfricaRice, please contact us via the 'Partnerships' section on our website. We welcome partnerships with governments, NGOs, and private sectors to advance rice research and development initiatives across Africa.

What industries does AfricaRice support through its research initiatives?

AfricaRice primarily supports the agricultural industry, focusing on rice production and agronomy. Our research initiatives aim to enhance productivity, sustainability, and food security, benefiting farmers, policymakers, and stakeholders involved in the rice value chain.

Can I find information about AfricaRice's projects and initiatives?

Yes, detailed information about AfricaRice's ongoing projects and initiatives can be found in the 'Projects' section of our website. This includes insights into our research focus areas, partnerships, and the impact of our work on food security and poverty alleviation in Africa.

About Georgia Society Sons of the American Revolution
-----------------------------------------------------

The outstanding participation of our 29 chapters and nearly 1,400 members consistently brings national recognition to our Society as we work to perpetuate the people and events of the American Revolution, promote patriotism, and preserve the ideals of freedom.  
  
We conduct scholarship and recognition programs for high school and elementary school students, for ROTC and JROTC cadets, and for Eagle Scouts. Many of our members go into school classrooms, often in Revolutionary War uniforms or other period dress, and make presentations on the people and events of the Revolution, the Declaration of Independence, the United States Constitution, and other patriotic themes. We present medals of recognition to our public safety officials, perform volunteer work with Veterans, and conduct Revolutionary War grave dedications. Our Chapters proudly recognize deserving schools, businesses, and organizations with Flag Certificates for their proper and prominent display of the American Flag. Our Society is an active participant in historic battle site observances and other patriotic programs. The award-winning Georgia Society Color Guard participates in parades and posts the Colors at civic and historic events. We also support and work closely with the Children of the American Revolution and the Daughters of the American Revolution.

What types of English language programs does FLS International offer?

FLS International offers a variety of English language programs tailored to meet the needs of international students. Additionally, FLS hosts summer camps designed for younger students, which combine language learning with engaging activities.

How does FLS International support students in university placement?

FLS International provides comprehensive university placement services to help students navigate the admissions process. FLS International's specialty programs cater to a variety of industries, including business, healthcare, technology, and hospitality. What services does Launchmetrics offer for the fashion industry?

Launchmetrics provides a comprehensive suite of services tailored for the fashion industry, including influencer marketing, PR monitoring, and digital asset management. Their platform enables brands to manage their digital assets effectively, track influencer campaigns, and monitor media coverage to enhance brand visibility and engagement. Additionally, Launchmetrics offers tools for creating virtual lookbooks and managing digital samples, streamlining the process of showcasing collections to buyers and influencers.

How does Launchmetrics support event management?

Launchmetrics supports event management by offering tools that help brands plan, execute, and analyze their events effectively. Their platform allows users to manage guest lists, track RSVPs, and coordinate logistics. Furthermore, Launchmetrics provides analytics to measure event success, including media coverage and social media engagement, ensuring that brands can optimize their future events based on data-driven insights.

What is the role of influencer marketing in Launchmetrics' offerings?

Influencer marketing is a key component of Launchmetrics' offerings, enabling brands to connect with relevant influencers to amplify their marketing efforts. The platform provides tools to identify and engage with influencers, track campaign performance, and measure ROI. By leveraging data analytics, brands can optimize their influencer partnerships and ensure that their messaging resonates with target audiences, ultimately driving brand awareness and sales.

Can Launchmetrics help with PR monitoring and media coverage analysis?

Yes, Launchmetrics offers robust PR monitoring capabilities that allow brands to track media coverage and analyze their public relations efforts. The platform aggregates data from various media sources, providing insights into how brands are perceived in the market. Users can monitor mentions, assess sentiment, and evaluate the impact of their PR campaigns, enabling them to make informed decisions and adjust their strategies accordingly.

What industries does Launchmetrics cater to?

Launchmetrics primarily caters to the fashion, luxury, and cosmetics industries. Their solutions are designed to meet the unique needs of these sectors, providing tools for influencer marketing, event management, and digital asset management. By focusing on these industries, Launchmetrics helps brands enhance their visibility, streamline their operations, and engage effectively with their target audiences.

How does Launchmetrics facilitate digital asset management?

Launchmetrics facilitates digital asset management by providing a centralized platform for brands to store, organize, and share their digital assets, such as images, videos, and lookbooks. The platform allows users to create virtual lookbooks that can be easily shared with stakeholders, including buyers and influencers. Additionally, Launchmetrics offers features for tracking the usage of digital assets, ensuring that brands can maintain control over their content and maximize its impact across various channels.

-------------------------------------------------

La Corporació Catalana de Mitjans Audiovisuals és l'ens públic que gestiona els mitjans de comunicació audiovisual de la Generalitat de Catalunya, els canals de Televisió de Catalunya i el grup d'emissores de Catalunya Ràdio, a més dels continguts digitals generats per aquests mitjans. Ho fa en compliment de la seva missió de servei públic i amb un ferm compromís de qualitat, independència i promoció de la cultura i la llengua catalanes. També en forma part la Fundació La Marató de TV3, que promou la sensibilització social i la recerca biomèdica.La CCMA participa en un 30% en l'Agència Catalana de Notícies (ACN), una empresa de capital públic, que gestiona serveis i activitats de comunicació escrita, ràdio i televisió en l'àmbit local i comarcal de les zones de parla catalana i de tot el territori espanyol.La Corporació és membre de la FORTA (Federació d'Organismes de Ràdio i Televisió Autonòmics) des de la seva constitució, l'abril del 1989. Aquesta entitat associa les ràdios i televisions autonòmiques, amb l'objectiu de cooperar en els àmbits dels drets de propietat intel·lectual, transmissions, intercanvi de programes i serveis o participació en organismes internacionals.Forma part de la UER-EBU (Unió Europea de Radiodifusió), a través de Catalunya Música, que participa en l'intercanvi musical Euroradio d'aquest organisme que agrupa tots els ens públics i les principals empreses privades de ràdio i televisió d'Europa.També està associada a CIRCOM Regional, que reuneix 376 televisions públiques de 38 països europeus amb l’objectiu de promoure i desenvolupar la cooperació entre els membres, en la coproducció i intercanvi de continguts audiovisuals i en la formació de periodistes i tècnics.

About Matt Painter

Matt Painter is an esteemed figure in American basketball, renowned for his exceptional coaching skills and dedication to the sport. Born on August 27, 1970, in Muncie, Indiana, Painter's love for basketball started at a young age. As a high school player, he displayed remarkable talent, leading his team to consecutive state championships in 1988 and 1989. This success laid the foundation for his future career as a coach, where he would go on to make a significant impact on the sport.  
  
After high school, Painter took his skills to Purdue University, where he played as a guard for the Boilermakers from 1989 to 1993. Though not the most athletically gifted player, his determination and basketball IQ set him apart. Coaches and teammates admired his work ethic and leadership on the court, qualities that would prove invaluable in his later coaching endeavors.  
  
Following his college playing career, Painter began his coaching journey as an assistant at Washington & Jefferson College in Pennsylvania. It didn't take long for his ability to inspire and develop players to come to the forefront. After two seasons, he moved on to work as an assistant at Eastern Illinois University, followed by a year at Southern Illinois University. His reputation as a diligent and committed coach continued to grow, catching the attention of esteemed basketball programs.  
  
In 2004, Painter received a life-changing opportunity when he was appointed as the head coach of the Southern Illinois Salukis men's basketball team. Taking over a successful program, he faced the challenge of maintaining its winning tradition. Unfazed by the pressure, Painter thrived, leading the Salukis to two NCAA tournament appearances in his brief tenure. His astute tactical knowledge, coupled with the ability to motivate his team, propelled Southern Illinois to new heights.  
  
This impressive stint at Southern Illinois did not go unnoticed, and in 2005, Painter was offered the head coaching position at his alma mater, Purdue University. This appointment served as a homecoming for the Indiana native, who was eager to restore the Boilermakers' basketball program to its former glory. As a coach, he emphasized discipline, hard work, and selflessness – principles he himself embodied.  
  
Painter's coaching philosophy was centered around versatility and adaptability. He strategically tailored his game plans to maximize his team's strengths while exploiting the weaknesses of opponents. His ability to make in-game adjustments and motivate his players fueled Purdue's resurgence as a force to be reckoned with in the highly competitive Big Ten Conference.  
  
Under Painter's leadership, the Boilermakers enjoyed tremendous success, consistently contending for conference championships and securing NCAA tournament berths year after year. His teams were known for their defensive prowess and unselfish play, characteristics that mirrored their coach's mentality. Brushed with a touch of Painter's magic, several players from Purdue went on to have successful careers in the NBA, a testament to his ability to develop talent.  
  
Off the court, Painter's impact is equally profound. He prioritizes the academic well-being of his players, pushing them to excel not only as athletes but also as students. His commitment to their holistic development has earned him respect and admiration from Purdue's administration, players, and fans alike.  
  
Moreover, Painter's contributions extend beyond the basketball court. He actively engages with the community, organizing events and activities that promote unity, teamwork, and youth development. His dedication to nurturing the next generation of leaders goes beyond the confines of the hardwood, making him not only an exceptional coach but also a role model.  
  
In conclusion, Matt Painter's journey from a talented high school player to one of the most respected basketball coaches in America is a testament to his unwavering passion and work ethic. His ability to inspire, develop, and maximize the potential of his players sets him apart. With a legacy firmly rooted in transforming programs, guiding players to success, and impacting communities, Painter's basketball journey is an awe-inspiring tale of resilience, leadership, and a profound love for the game.

What types of services does Amazing Home Care provide?

Amazing Home Care offers a wide range of services tailored to meet the needs of our clients. Our services include personal care assistance, companionship, nursing care, medication management, and rehabilitation support. We also provide specialized care for individuals with chronic illnesses, disabilities, and those recovering from surgery. Our goal is to enhance the quality of life for our clients while ensuring their safety and comfort in their own homes.

Are your caregivers licensed and trained?

Yes, all caregivers at Amazing Home Care are fully accredited and undergo rigorous training to ensure they meet the highest standards of care. Our team includes licensed nurses, certified nursing assistants, and skilled caregivers who are trained in various aspects of home health care. We prioritize ongoing education and training to keep our staff updated on the best practices in caregiving.

How do I know if home care is right for my loved one?

Determining if home care is the right choice for your loved one involves considering their specific needs and circumstances. If your loved one requires assistance with daily activities, medical care, or companionship, home care can provide a safe and supportive environment. We recommend scheduling a consultation with our team, who can assess the situation and recommend a personalized care plan that meets your loved one's needs.

What industries does Amazing Home Care support?

Amazing Home Care primarily supports the healthcare industry, focusing on home health care services for individuals in need. We cater to a diverse clientele, including seniors, individuals with disabilities, and those recovering from medical procedures. Our services are designed to complement various healthcare settings, including hospitals, rehabilitation centers, and assisted living facilities, ensuring a seamless transition to home care.

How does Amazing Home Care ensure the safety and well-being of its clients?

Safety and well-being are our top priorities at Amazing Home Care. We conduct thorough background checks on all caregivers and provide ongoing training in safety protocols and emergency procedures. Additionally, we develop personalized care plans that include safety assessments for each client’s home environment. Regular communication with clients and their families helps us monitor progress and address any concerns promptly.

How can I get started with Amazing Home Care services?

Getting started with Amazing Home Care is easy! You can contact us through our website or call our office directly to schedule a free consultation. During this initial meeting, we will discuss your loved one's needs, evaluate their situation, and create a customized care plan. Our team will guide you through the process, including any necessary paperwork and insurance inquiries, to ensure a smooth transition to home care.

About Connect Catering Ltd
--------------------------

About Connect  
With over 30 years’ experience running catering operations, Connect’s experience and knowledge ensures we deliver what we promise. Connect is a family owned and operated company, founded in 1989 by Chairman, John Herring, and two of his daughters, Kate Bendall and Louise Laver, are Joint Managing Directors. Connect employ over 450 staff who are highly motivated and thoroughly trained; crucial factors in delivering an excellent catering service. We take great care of our clients and staff, ensuring close working relationships and long term partnerships. Connect were placed 1st in The Sunday Times Top 100 Best Companies To Work For 2019 and 2nd in 2020. We provide catering to 74 contracts with an annual operating turnover in excess of £15.5 million.  
  
Food Philosophy  
Fresh food is an embedded principal at Connect. Each Chef Manager writes their own menus, to take advantage of seasonal produce, customer preferences and special offers. Each dish is created from the basic raw ingredients creating balanced nutritious meals that are tasty and delicious. Special dietary requirements and allergy awareness is always accommodated to ensure every person can enjoy the catering facility.  
  
Delivering Excellence Through Training  
We nurture flair, passion and talent, taking great care of every individual as demonstrated by our retained Investors in People Gold award. Connect trains and inspires Managers, Chefs and their teams through internal and external courses, catering meetings, advice and support from their Operations Manager. During the handover period of every new contract we carefully support the team on site, enabling them to continue to provide the very best possible service.  
  
Budget Control  
Connect delivered this through specific training and development programmes and open book accounting. Connect produce bespoke trading reports, designed to give the client all the information required.

About Senetas Corporation
-------------------------

Senetas is a global leader in cybersecurity; trusted to protect commercial, government, defence and critical infrastructure data in over 40 countries. From data network encryption to secure file-sharing and proactive anti-malware protection, all are based on the same crypto-agile principles and deliver security without compromise.  
  
CN Series Hardware Encryptors  
Certified high-assurance encryption for core IT and network infrastructure  
Certified by leading independent authorities (Common Criteria, FIPS and NATO), the CN Series of hardware encryptors are used to secure sensitive data in motion across networks operating at anything from modest 10Mbps to ultra-fast 100Gbps bandwidths.  
  
CV Series Virtual Encryptors  
Virtualised encryption for large-scale and virtualised Wide Area Networks  
Scalable to thousands of endpoints, the CV series of virtual encryptors is a software application of the trusted Senetas encryption platform. It delivers cost-effective, transport Layer agnostic data protection at up to 5Gbps (with DPDK).  
  
SureDrop Encrypted File-Sharing  
The secure file-sharing application with 100% control over data sovereignty  
SureDrop delivers the usability, familiarity and convenience of a box-style file sharing application plus the implementation of best-in-class security. It is available both as an on-premises solution, or a Security-as-a-Service proposition from your Cloud service provider.  
  
Votiro Secure File Gateway  
The proactive anti-malware solution that protects against undisclosed threats  
Traditional anti-malware solutions are reactive by nature, ensuring cyber criminals are always one step ahead. Votiro is a revolution in anti-malware. Its patented, proactive technology protects against the most persistent threats, including undisclosed or zero-day attacks.

About Dartmouth-Hitchcock
-------------------------

Dartmouth-Hitchcock, headquartered at One Medical Center Drive in Lebanon, New Hampshire, stands as a premier health system in the Upper Valley region, serving both New Hampshire and Vermont. Renowned for its patient-centered care, Dartmouth-Hitchcock encompasses a comprehensive network that includes the Dartmouth-Hitchcock Medical Center, the NCI-designated Norris Cotton Cancer Center, and the Children's Hospital at Dartmouth-Hitchcock. With four affiliated hospitals and 30 ambulatory clinics, the system is dedicated to providing a wide array of services, including primary care, specialty care, surgical services, and advanced cancer treatment, all supported by cutting-edge medical technologies and research initiatives.  
  
Living in New Hampshire and Vermont offers a unique lifestyle that beautifully complements a career at Dartmouth-Hitchcock. The region is celebrated for its stunning four-season environment, providing ample opportunities for outdoor activities such as skiing, hiking, and enjoying the picturesque landscapes. With no income or sales tax, professionals can enjoy a higher quality of life while contributing to one of the top health systems in the nation. The area is strategically located near major urban centers like Boston, New York, and Montreal, ensuring that residents can enjoy both the tranquility of rural living and the vibrancy of city life.  
  
Dartmouth-Hitchcock is committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive workplace, welcoming qualified applicants from all backgrounds without regard to race, color, religion, gender, national origin, disability status, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. This commitment, combined with the region's rich history and thriving business environment, makes Dartmouth-Hitchcock an ideal place for healthcare professionals to grow their careers while enjoying a fulfilling lifestyle in one of the best places to live and work in the United States.

About Vuelo Tequila - Blach Spirits Group, Inc.

Our award-winning artisanal tequila is handcrafted with the finest attention to detail. We begin with handpicked estate grown blue weber agaves which have matured for 7 to 9 years.  
  
Our agaves are then slow cooked in natural clay ovens for 72 hours, fermented and copper pot distilled.  
  
Our Gran Reserva Plata is allowed to rest for 4 months to ensure the utmost quality.  
  
Our Gran Reserva Reposado is rested in French and American oak barrels for 9 months and meticulously blended to achieve its smooth and remarkable finish.  
  
Our Gran Reserva Añejo is aged in Napa Valley red wine barrels for 2 years to achieve its exquisite finish and delicate notes.  
Our Gran Reserva Extra Añejo is aged in whiskey and red wine barrels for 5 to 7 years to achieve its luxurious complexity.  
  
We are deeply honored to share our voyage with you.

About Brigham and Women's Hospital
----------------------------------

Boston's Brigham and Women's Hospital (BWH) is an international leader in virtually every area of medicine and has been the site of pioneering breakthroughs that have improved lives around the world. A major teaching hospital of Harvard Medical School, BWH has a legacy of excellence that continues to grow. With two outstanding hospitals, over 150 outpatient practices, and over 1,200 physicians, we serve patients from New England, throughout the United States, and from 120 countries around the world.  
  
The BWH name is a reflection of our history. In 1980 three of Boston’s oldest and most prestigious Harvard Medical School teaching hospitals - the Peter Bent Brigham Hospital, the Robert Breck Brigham Hospital, and the Boston Hospital for Women – merged to form Brigham and Women’s Hospital.  
  
As a national leader in improving health care quality and safety, we have helped to develop some of the industry’s best practices including computerized physician order entry (CPOE) to prevent medication errors. The CPOE is now a nationally-accepted safety practice.  
  
The BWH Biomedical Research Institute (BRI) is one of the most powerful biomedical research institutes in the world and the second largest recipient of National Institutes of Health (NIH) funding among independent hospitals in the United States. BWH has long had great success in research as measured by the number of important discoveries made, the size and scope of its research portfolio and the volume of publications annually.  
  
BWH is a training ground for physicians, nurses, and allied health professionals. We have 1,100 trainees in over 140 of the most sought after training programs in the world, and also host Harvard Medical School students in rotations throughout our programs. As our global health services expand, our clinical trainees have rich opportunities to contribute and learn in challenging environments around the world.  
  
Brigham and Women's Hospital is an EEO, AA, VEVRAA Employer.

About AppViewX
--------------

The world runs on applications. “Yes, we have an app for that” is now part of our daily lexicon whether as consumers or employees. So, while application availability, access, security and compliance are critical to our user experience and productivity, why do we continue to see application downtime? The answer is simple…too many cooks in the proverbial kitchen. DevOps teams are doing this. NetOps teams are doing that. SecOps teams are doing something different. Even though all of them have one essential goal: to ensure application access and availability, security and compliance. About Shutterstock
------------------

Shutterstock, Inc. (NYSE: SSTK), is a leading global creative platform offering full-service solutions, high-quality content, and tools for brands, businesses and media companies. Directly and through its group subsidiaries, Shutterstock's comprehensive collection includes high-quality licensed photographs, vectors, illustrations, videos, 3D models and music. Working with its growing community of over 1.7 million contributors, Shutterstock adds hundreds of thousands of images each week, and currently has more than 400 million images and more than 21 million video clips available.  
  
At Shutterstock we understand that Diversity, Equity and Inclusion makes us more effective and is essential to innovation. We are deeply focused on equality and are committed to diversity across areas including race, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, disability, religion, ethnicity and national origin. Guided by our Seek Diversity principle, our goal is to build a workforce, contributor network, and content library that is representative of the diverse global community.  
  
Inclusive Culture  
We want our employees to come to work as their authentic selves and feel comfortable sharing their ideas, experiences and perspectives to fuel the creative and innovative products we deliver to our customers.  
Recruitment and Retention  
We believe that diverse and inclusive teams create the most innovative work. We also know that they are more committed to building a diverse pipeline and recognizing the value of varying perspectives.  
Business and Community  
Shutterstock is focused on creating the best experience for our global community of contributors and customers. We’re committed to featuring diverse visuals and contributors, elevating the voices of historically excluded groups, and working with our contributors to ensure our content accurately represents the world and brings visibility to those who are traditionally excluded.

Wir bieten eine Pflege nach den neuesten wissenschaftlichen Erkenntnissen. Dem hohen Anspruch folgend, arbeiten wir im Qualitätsmanagement nach den Standards des Diakonie-Siegels „Pflege“, das neben qualitätssichernden, gesetzlichen Vorgaben christliche und ethische Werte berücksichtigt. Auch ehrenamtliche Helferinnen und Helfer leisten bei uns einen wichtigen Beitrag in der Seniorenarbeit. Zudem ist die Johanniter Seniorenhäuser GmbH Mitglied des Diakonischen Werks der Evangelischen Kirche in Deutschland.

About Eddie Levert

Eddie Levert is an iconic American singer, best known for his soulful and powerful vocals as the lead singer of the popular R&B group, The O'Jays. Born on June 16, 1942, in Bessemer, Alabama, Levert's talent and passion for music ignited at an early age. His rich baritone voice and heartfelt performances have garnered him immense respect and admiration from fans and fellow musicians alike.  
  
Levert's journey in the music industry started in his hometown, where he and childhood friends Walter Williams and William Powell formed a vocal group called The Triumphs. They soon caught the attention of producer Eddie O'Jay, who not only became their mentor but also inspired them to change their group's name to The O'Jays. Under O'Jay's guidance, Levert and his bandmates honed their skills and developed a unique sound that blended soul, R&B, funk, and disco.  
  
In 1972, The O'Jays signed with Philadelphia International Records, a label founded by acclaimed producers Kenny Gamble and Leon Huff. This collaboration proved to be a turning point in the group's career, as they released chart-topping hits such as "Back Stabbers" and "Love Train." With Eddie Levert's captivating voice leading the way, The O'Jays became known for their socially conscious lyrics and infectious melodies, becoming one of the most successful R&B acts of the 1970s.  
  
Levert's vocal abilities were widely recognized, and his passionate performances showcased his ability to connect with audiences on a deep emotional level. The intensity in his voice, coupled with his charismatic stage presence, made him a captivating performer who could effortlessly command a crowd. His soul-stirring vocal range and innate ability to convey heartfelt emotions elevated his performances to unforgettable heights, leaving fans in awe and yearning for more.  
  
While The O'Jays were a dominant force in the music scene, Eddie Levert also established himself as a solo artist. In 1985, he released his debut solo album, "I Still Have It," which showcased his versatility as a solo performer. The album's lead single, "I Still Have It in My Heart," achieved moderate success and solidified Levert as an artist capable of standing on his own. His subsequent solo albums, such as "Father & Son" (1995) and "Did I Make You Go Ooh" (2016), continued to showcase his distinctive voice and reputation as a seasoned performer.  
  
Throughout his career, Eddie Levert has collaborated with numerous artists across various genres, further cementing his status as an influential figure in the music industry. From Marvin Gaye to Teena Marie, Levert's collaborations have brought his velvety vocals to new interpretations and audiences. His duets with his three sons, Gerald Levert, Sean Levert, and Marc Gordon, collectively known as LeVert, have also yielded chart-topping hits and secured the Levert name as a musical dynasty.  
  
Beyond his musical accomplishments, Eddie Levert is admired for his philanthropic efforts and commitment to giving back to his community. He and his late son, Gerald, founded the Levert Family Foundation, a nonprofit organization dedicated to providing educational opportunities and support for underprivileged youth. Levert's dedication to creating a positive impact extends beyond the stage, making him an inspirational figure both on and off the spotlight.  
  
In summary, Eddie Levert's mesmerizing baritone voice and powerful performances have solidified his place as a legendary American singer. From his early beginnings with The O'Jays to his successful solo endeavors, Levert's soulful delivery and emotional range have captivated audiences worldwide. With a career spanning over six decades, he has left an indelible mark on the music industry, influencing generations of artists with his distinctive vocal style and unwavering passion. Eddie Levert's legacy continues to shine brightly, earning him a well-deserved spot among the greatest vocalists of his time.

About McKim & Creed, Inc.
-------------------------

What if you had the opportunity to do something you love and make a difference in peoples'​ lives at the same time?  
  
As engineers and surveyors, we use some pretty cool tools (think LiDAR, unmanned aerial systems \[UAS\], modeling, etc.) to solve some of today’s (and tomorrow’s) infrastructure challenges. But providing technical solutions isn’t enough. We have the incredible opportunity to help improve people’s lives. Like providing clean water. Designing energy-efficient facilities. Protecting fragile coastlines. Planning sustainable communities. And helping recent graduates launch new careers.  
  
McKim & Creed is a company of people helping people. Our employee-owned firm has more than 500 staff members in offices throughout the U.S., including North Carolina, South Carolina, Florida, Virginia, Georgia, Texas, and Pennsylvania. We specialize in mechanical, electrical, plumbing, civil and structural engineering; industrial design-build services; landscape architecture; airborne and mobile LiDAR/scanning; unmanned aerial systems; subsurface utility engineering; and hydrographic and conventional surveying services for the energy, transportation, federal, land development, water and building markets.  
  
For more information about McKim & Creed and our “people helping people” approach to the built environment, visit www.mckimcreed.com.

What types of video streaming services does DaCast offer?

DaCast provides a comprehensive range of video streaming services, including live streaming, video hosting, and video on demand (VOD). Their platform supports various streaming formats and allows businesses to broadcast content in real-time or store it for later viewing. Additionally, DaCast offers options for monetization through pay-per-view (PPV) and subscription models, making it suitable for a wide range of industries.

How does DaCast ensure the quality and reliability of its streaming services?

DaCast utilizes a robust Content Delivery Network (CDN) to ensure high-quality and reliable streaming. Their CDN distributes content across multiple servers globally, reducing latency and buffering for viewers. This infrastructure is designed to handle high traffic volumes, ensuring that streams remain stable and accessible, even during peak viewing times.

Can I monetize my content using DaCast, and what options are available?

Yes, DaCast provides several monetization options for content creators. You can choose to implement pay-per-view (PPV) pricing, where viewers pay for individual access to specific content, or set up subscription models that allow users to access a library of content for a recurring fee. Additionally, DaCast supports ad monetization, enabling you to integrate advertisements into your streams.

What industries can benefit from using DaCast's streaming solutions?

DaCast's streaming solutions cater to a diverse range of industries, including education, sports, entertainment, corporate communications, and religious organizations. Whether you're looking to host live events, deliver training sessions, or broadcast sports games, DaCast provides the tools and infrastructure necessary to reach your audience effectively.

Is DaCast suitable for both small businesses and large enterprises?

Absolutely! DaCast is designed to be scalable, making it suitable for both small businesses and large enterprises. Their platform offers flexible pricing plans and features that can be tailored to meet the specific needs of any organization, regardless of size. This adaptability allows businesses to start small and expand their streaming capabilities as they grow.

What kind of support does DaCast offer to its users?

DaCast provides comprehensive support to its users, including a detailed knowledge base, video tutorials, and customer support via email and chat. Their team is dedicated to helping users troubleshoot issues, optimize their streaming experience, and make the most of the platform's features. About TaskRabbit
----------------

Taskrabbit is a marketplace platform that conveniently connects people with Taskers to handle everyday home to-do’s, such as furniture assembly, handyman work, moving help, and much more. Acquired by IKEA Group - the world’s largest furniture retailer - in 2017  
  
At Taskrabbit, we want to make your neighborhood a little more familiar. Whether it’s a handyman (or woman!), a housecleaner, moving help or delivery person, we’re imagining a world where everyone will have a go-to team to make everyday life easier. As a company we celebrate innovation, inclusion and hard work.  
  
As a pioneer of the sharing economy, Taskrabbit was founded on the premise of neighbors helping neighbors. Since then, our network has grown to eight countries and 75+ cities, yet our core mission of creating a better everyday life for everyday people has remained the same.  
  
Together with IKEA, we’re creating more opportunities for people to earn a consistent, meaningful income on their own terms by building lasting relationships with clients in communities around the world.  
  
We are a group of mission-minded people. Our culture is collaborative, pragmatic, and fast-paced. We’re looking for talented, entrepreneurially-minded and data-driven people who also have a passion for helping people do what they love - and have a ton of fun while they’re at it.

About Tesla Engineering Ltd.

Tesla Engineering Ltd., headquartered in Storrington, England, is a pioneering force in the design and manufacture of advanced electromagnetic systems. With a strong focus on innovation, the company specializes in resistive and superconducting electromagnets tailored for a variety of high-tech applications. Their expertise extends to producing gradient coils for magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) scanners, which are essential in the medical field for non-invasive imaging, as well as coil systems for fusion reactors, contributing to the development of sustainable energy solutions.  
  
Tesla Engineering is also a key player in the semiconductor industry, providing high-performance magnets for ion implanter machines that are critical in the fabrication of integrated circuits. The company’s commitment to quality and precision is evident in its use of cutting-edge technologies, ensuring that their products meet the rigorous demands of scientific research and industrial applications.  
  
By serving diverse industries, including healthcare, energy, and semiconductor manufacturing, Tesla Engineering Ltd. plays a vital role in advancing technology and innovation. Their team of skilled engineers and scientists continually push the boundaries of electromagnet design, focusing on efficiency and performance. With a reputation for reliability and excellence, Tesla Engineering is dedicated to delivering solutions that not only meet but exceed the expectations of their clients, solidifying their position as a leader in the electromagnetic systems market. About CORE Education Trust
--------------------------

CORE Education Trust, headquartered in Birmingham, England, is dedicated to transforming the educational landscape for children through a commitment to its four CORE Values: Collaboration, Opportunity, Respect, and Excellence. These values serve as the foundation for a high-quality educational experience, fostering an environment where both students and staff can thrive. By promoting collaboration, CORE Education Trust encourages an outward-facing approach that embraces new possibilities and partnerships. The value of opportunity inspires a culture of imagination and daring, pushing students to seek experiences that extend beyond the ordinary classroom setting.  
  
Respect is integral to the Trust’s ethos, as it cherishes the richness of diversity and emphasizes the importance of understanding one another. Excellence is not just a goal but a continuous journey, where achievements are celebrated while always striving for higher standards. Each school within the Trust is supported and monitored to ensure these values are deeply embedded in their culture, with bespoke “CORE Characteristics” tailored to the unique context of each institution.  
  
At the heart of CORE Education Trust's curriculum philosophy is a relentless focus on developing character and communication skills, essential for preparing students for future challenges. This holistic approach ensures that every child receives a well-rounded education, empowering them to become confident, capable individuals. For those interested in the teaching staff, the CORE Education Trust teachers list showcases a dedicated team committed to these principles, working collaboratively to inspire and nurture the next generation of learners.

About VeEX Inc
--------------

VeEX Inc. (www.veexinc.com), a communications Test and Measurement company, develops innovative Test Solutions for next generation telecommunication networks and services. A world leader in 400GE field testing, VeEX offer a comprehensive portfolio of test solutions for Fiber Optics, FTTx, PON, xWDM, Ethernet, eCPRI, Fibre Channel, Transport, Legacy, etc.

What types of test solutions does VeEX Inc. offer for telecommunications networks?

VeEX Inc. provides a wide range of test solutions designed for next-generation telecommunications networks. These include tools for measuring performance in areas such as Ethernet, Fiber Optics, Wi-Fi, and 5G. Their offerings encompass testing for various protocols and standards, including 400GE field testing, QoS (Quality of Service), QoE (Quality of Experience), and proactive network maintenance (PNM). Additionally, they support testing for data center environments, DOCSIS for cable networks, and synchronization technologies like 1588 and SyncE.

How does VeEX Inc. support the deployment of 5G networks?

VeEX Inc. plays a crucial role in the deployment of 5G networks by providing advanced test and measurement solutions that ensure network reliability and performance. Their products facilitate the testing of various 5G components, including fronthaul and backhaul connections, as well as the verification of network synchronization and latency. The company also offers solutions for measuring KPIs (Key Performance Indicators) that are essential for optimizing 5G services, ensuring that operators can deliver high-speed, low-latency connectivity to end-users.

What industries can benefit from VeEX's test and measurement solutions?

VeEX's test and measurement solutions are applicable across a variety of industries, including telecommunications, data centers, cable television (CATV), and enterprise networking. Service providers, network operators, and enterprises can utilize VeEX's tools to ensure the performance and reliability of their communication networks. Additionally, industries that rely on high-speed data transmission, such as cloud services, IoT (Internet of Things), and smart cities, can also benefit from VeEX's innovative testing solutions.

Can VeEX's solutions help with fiber optic network testing?

Yes, VeEX offers specialized solutions for fiber optic network testing, including Optical Time Domain Reflectometers (OTDR) and other measurement tools that assess the integrity and performance of fiber optic cables. These tools help technicians identify faults, measure loss, and ensure that fiber installations meet industry standards. VeEX's fiber testing solutions are essential for both installation and maintenance phases, enabling operators to deliver reliable fiber optic services.

What is the importance of proactive network maintenance (PNM) in telecommunications?

Proactive Network Maintenance (PNM) is critical in telecommunications as it allows operators to identify and resolve potential issues before they impact service quality. VeEX's PNM solutions enable continuous monitoring of network performance, helping to detect anomalies and degradation in real-time. By implementing PNM strategies, service providers can enhance customer satisfaction, reduce downtime, and optimize operational efficiency, ultimately leading to improved service delivery and reduced costs.

How does VeEX ensure the accuracy of its test measurements?

VeEX ensures the accuracy of its test measurements through rigorous calibration processes and adherence to industry standards. The company employs advanced technology and methodologies in the design of its test equipment, which are regularly updated to reflect the latest developments in telecommunications. Additionally, VeEX provides comprehensive training and support to its customers, ensuring they understand how to use the equipment correctly and interpret the results accurately. This commitment to quality and precision helps customers achieve reliable and consistent test outcomes.

About Biev
----------

1984 yılında açılan ilk züccaciye mağazası ile temelleri atılan Biev, doğuşu sayılabilecek bu ilk adımdan sonra ev - yaşam kültürünün gelişmesi ve zenginleşmesi yönünde sürdürdüğü çalışmaları ve yarattığı öncü markalarının ardından 2007 yılında kuruldu.  
  
Biev, kendisine ait mağazaları, franchise mağazaları ve online alışveriş sitesi ile seçkin bayi ve satış noktalarında kişiye özel ve keyifli alışveriş deneyimi sunarken, ev-yaşam trendlerine yön veren yenilikçi bakış açısı ile sıcak ve huzurlu alanlar yaratıyor.  
Hayattaki duruşunu, motivasyon kaynaklarını evi ile paylaşanlara yönelik mobilyadan aksesuara, aydınlatmadan ev tekstil grubuna geniş bir yelpazede dekorasyona dair pek çok farklı tarz ile müşterilerine yaratıcılıklarını ortaya çıkaracak fikirler sunan Biev, bugün milyonlarca evde dekorasyon zenginliği yaratıyor.  
  
‘’Hayalinizdeki gibi Biev’’ mottosu ile kendi stilini yaşam alanlarına yansıtanların vazgeçilmezi olan Biev, özgün bakış açısı, trendlere göre şekillendirdiği ürün çeşidi ve dekorasyona yönelik yaratıcı fikirlerinin yanı sıra güçlü marka kimliği ile dünya markası olma yolunda ilerlemeye devam ediyor.  
  
  
Founded in 2007, Biev’s ongoing efforts to develop and enrich a home and lifestyle culture by giving birth to pioneering brands dates back all the way to its first glassware store in 1984.  
While providing the pleasure of customized shopping experience for consumers both at its branded stores and select dealers, sales points, franchise stores and online shopping sites as well, Biev, with an innovative approach, creates heartwarming and peaceful living spaces and leads the way to home and lifestyle trends. Biev offers products and collections ranging from furniture to accessories, from lightning to home textile in almost every line of decoration to nurture the creativity of consumers who like reflecting their character to the living environment and so to create rich decorative atmospheres in millions of homes.  
  
With a unique vision, a strong brand identity, a product range of the latest trends and creative ideas for decorating, Biev marches towards being a world brand and continues to be indispensable for people who like reflecting their personal style to living spaces with the motto “Your Dream Home” in their mind.
