What types of products does Accupac specialize in manufacturing?

Accupac specializes in the contract manufacturing of personal care products, including but not limited to lotions, creams, gels, and other topical applications. With over 40 years of experience, we have developed expertise in producing high-quality formulations that meet the specific needs of our clients and their brands.

What quality assurance measures does Accupac implement in its manufacturing process?

Accupac adheres to stringent quality assurance protocols to ensure that all products meet the highest standards of safety and efficacy. Our facilities operate under current Good Manufacturing Practices (cGMP), and we conduct thorough testing and inspections throughout the manufacturing process. This includes raw material verification, in-process quality checks, and final product testing to ensure compliance with industry regulations.

Can Accupac handle large-scale production for established brands?

Yes, Accupac is equipped to handle large-scale production for established brands. Our state-of-the-art manufacturing facilities are designed to scale operations efficiently, ensuring that we can meet the demands of high-volume orders while maintaining product quality. We work closely with our clients to develop tailored solutions that align with their production needs and timelines.

What industries does Accupac serve?

Accupac primarily serves the personal care industry, but our contract manufacturing services extend to a variety of sectors, including cosmetics, pharmaceuticals, and health and wellness products. Our versatile capabilities allow us to adapt to the specific requirements of different industries, ensuring that we deliver products that meet regulatory standards and consumer expectations.

How does Accupac ensure compliance with industry regulations?

Accupac takes compliance very seriously and implements a comprehensive approach to meet industry regulations. Our facilities are regularly audited to ensure adherence to cGMP guidelines, and we stay updated on the latest regulatory changes affecting the personal care and cosmetics industries. Additionally, our quality assurance team is dedicated to maintaining compliance at every stage of the manufacturing process.

What is the process for starting a contract manufacturing partnership with Accupac?

To initiate a contract manufacturing partnership with Accupac, interested parties can reach out through our website or contact our sales team directly. We will schedule a consultation to discuss your specific needs, product requirements, and production timelines. Following this, we will provide a proposal outlining our capabilities, pricing, and next steps to move forward with the partnership.

About Total Hockey
------------------

Since its founding in 1999, Total Hockey Inc. has designed and built itself into the leader in hockey equipment specialty retailing. Entering a staid retail marketplace that was largely content to look the same year after year—small, dingy stores; unsophisticated systems; inward looking management—THI dragged hockey retail first into the 20th century, then into the 21st.  
  
THI’s growth has been robust from humble beginnings in St. Louis. Our first extra-home market store opened in December of 2006. THI is now in twelve metro markets with 32 stores. And we have ambitious plans for more. THI entered lacrosse retail in 2012, now has four lacrosse stores, and is beginning to drive change in that sport’s retail framework as well. THI boast significant ecommerce penetration in both hockey and lacrosse businesses.  
  
But it isn’t the growth that is most engaging or exciting; it is how THI is revolutionizing the retail experience for the customer and energizing the marketplace with initiatives to get players to start playing these great sports. By giving the consumer a fully active retail environment that provides access to advice, information, technical specifications, reviews, product demonstration videos, product comparisons, and more, THI delivers a robust, leading-edge omni-channel experience. Interacting across brick and mortar and various digital platforms, customers have a vital, 360 degree view of how hockey and lacrosse gear and apparel can enhance their sports and life experiences. Further, in conjunction with key governing organizations, e.g., THI is the exclusive retailer partner of USA Hockey and sponsor partner with several state bodies, THI is instrumental in bringing thousands of new players into the games each year.  
  
Follow @TotalHockey on Facebook, Twitter, Instagram, YouTube, Vine and Google+  
  
For more information or any Customer Service needs please call 1.866.929.6699.

About SGS Enger Engenharia Ltda.
--------------------------------

Empresa de engenharia consultiva, a Enger atua na prestação de serviços de gerenciamento de programas e empreendimentos, nas etapas de concepção, viabilização, implantação e operação, usando metodologia gerencial própria. Conciliando a tecnologia com reais demandas do meio e do contexto em que atua, a Enger possibilita a concepção de um modelo de gerenciamento diferenciado para cada empreendimento.  
Essa expertise vem juntar-se à do Grupo SGS, que em 06 de maio de 2013 adquiriu 100% de seu capital. Com esta aquisição estratégica, o Grupo SGS aumenta seu escopo de serviços na área industrial, onde já atua em inspeção, ensaios mecânicos, calibração, comissionamento, manutenção, montagens para plantas de processo, principalmente no setor de óleo, gás e petroquímicos, química, alimentos, papel e celulose, siderurgia e vidro, automotivo entre outras, sendo o líder mundial nestas áreas de competência.  
  
A SGS, com sede em Genebra, na Suíça, foi fundada em 1878 e hoje tem mais de 75.000 funcionários e 1.500 escritórios nos 142 países onde atua.  
  
No Brasil desde 1938, o Grupo SGS atua com serviços diversificados como inspeções e certificações para o trade internacional em commodities, bens de consumo e bens industriais, comissionamento de plantas industriais, análise geoquímica, certificação de produtos e de sistemas de gestão, serviços para o meio ambiente, fornecimento de pessoal técnico especializado, entre outros.

We have 7000 square meter manufacturing facility in Electronics City, Bangalore that houses State of the art hybrid fabrication facility, Electronic Manufacturing lines and Environmental and Reliability evaluation facilities.  
  
KHMDL has delivered more than 40,000 complex Avionics Board Assembly incorporated to more than 450 Aircrafts.  
  
The core capability of KHMD include Design, Development and Manufacture of Thick Film Hybrid Micro Circuits catering to Aerospace, Defense and Automotive Segments.  
  
The design and development group of KHMD has developed HMC based Electronic Control Units for Aircraft, Bio-medical & Automotive applications.  
  
With comprehensive Environmental Testing and Reliability capabilities, KHMDL can deliver turnkey solutions meeting the stringent requirements of space aircraft and other high-reliability segments.

About Unimed Piracicaba
-----------------------

A Unimed Piracicaba é o resultado de uma trajetória de empreendedorismo, que teve início em 14 de dezembro de 1970, quando um grupo de médicos ousados criaram uma pequena cooperativa para garantir trabalho e remuneração digna para a classe. Hoje, com 590 sócios e mais de 180 mil clientes na cidade e região, a instituição integra o maior sistema de saúde da América Latina, além de ser líder no mercado de planos de saúde de Piracicaba e figurar entre as 50 Melhores & Maiores empresas do país.  
  
Desde a sua fundação, a cooperativa de médicos sabe que criar o futuro é uma tarefa que se cumpre no presente e, por isso, aposta em ações de estímulo à prevenção e qualidade de vida de seus clientes, médicos e colaboradores.  
  
Ao longo desses anos, a Unimed Piracicaba aprimorou seus serviços e criou uma rede própria, que hoje conta com um moderno e completo centro médico – Hospital Unimed; certificado pela ONA (Organização Nacional de Acreditação), além de atendimentos especializados na Unimed Domiciliar e Unimed Medicina Preventiva. Em 2015, a Cooperativa inaugurou a Unimed Corpo e Mente, espaço voltado à saúde emocional de clientes, e o Núcleo de Atenção Primária à Saúde (Naps), reservado exclusivamente ao atendimento de integrantes da Associação dos Aposentados Metalúrgicos de Piracicaba nas áreas da geriatria, cardiologia, medicina preventiva, enfermagem, nutrição, fisioterapia, psicologia e terapia ocupacional.  
  
Há mais de quatro décadas, a Cooperativa acredita que o melhor plano de saúde é viver e vive apaixonadamente cada segundo do seu trabalho para oferecer a melhor assistência da região. Por isso, a cada ano, a Unimed Piracicaba renova seu juramento de proporcionar saúde de excelência aos seus clientes, de forma humana, ética e transparente. Afinal, é isso que faz toda a diferença para cuidar do maior patrimônio do mundo: a vida das pessoas.

About Palatin Technologies
--------------------------

Palatin (NYSE American: PTN) is a biopharmaceutical company developing first-in-class medicines based on molecules that modulate the activity of the melanocortin peptide receptor system. The melanocortin system is involved in regulating important physiological activities such as food intake and energy balance, desire and arousal, and the resolution of harmful inflammation. We are the first company to obtain FDA approval for a melanocortin based therapeutic, Vyleesi®, a treatment for women with hypoactive sexual desire disorder (HSDD).  
  
With the successful development of Vyleesi® and our extensive experience in the development of melanocortin based therapeutics, we are now focused on developing therapeutics that take advantage of the key role that the melanocortin system plays in the resolution of harmful inflammation. This has the potential to treat diseases that affect the eye, gastrointestinal system and the kidney.  
  
Our most advanced ocular product is PL9643, a topical treatment for dry eye disease, which is targeted to enter Phase 3 clinical trials in 2H 2021. We also have therapeutics in earlier stages of development for ophthalmic indications such as non-infectious uveitis, retinopathies and corneal diseases.  
  
Therapeutics that modulate the activity of the melanocortin system will have broad utility and to establish this, we are planning to conduct proof of concept clinical studies in ulcerative colitis and kidney disease.  
  
Vyleesi® is the first and only on-demand, FDA-approved treatment for premenopausal women suffering with HSDD, which affects 1 in 10 pre-menopausal women. Learn about this condition here: https://www.unblush.com/  
  
To learn more about Vyleesi®, including Important Safety Information, visit here: https://www.vyleesi.com/  
  
We are very excited by the tremendous potential our therapeutics have to positively impact the lives of patients and the value we can build for our shareholders. Find more information about our programs: www.palatin.com

At AtaCor Medical, we envision a new world of cardiac rhythm management. \- Eliminate the complications associated with transvenous leads

The AtaCor EV Temporary Pacing System is under development and not approved for sale in any geography.

About Cardlytics
----------------

Cardlytics (NASDAQ: CDLX) is an advertising platform in banks' digital channels. We partner with financial institutions to run their banking rewards programs that promote customer loyalty and deepen banking relationships. In turn, we have a secure view into where and when consumers are spending their money. We use these insights to help marketers identify, reach, and influence likely buyers at scale, as well as measure the true sales impact of marketing campaigns.

About Proenza Schouler
----------------------

Proenza Schouler is a New York based womenswear and accessories brand founded in 2002 by designers Jack McCollough and Lazaro Hernandez. The duo met while studying at Parsons School of Design, eventually collaborating on their senior thesis which became their first collection as Proenza Schouler. Named after the designers’ mothers’ maiden names, the collection was bought in its entirety by Barneys New York.  
  
Proenza Schouler makes luxury fashion for the intelligent, adult, urban woman of today. The work is generally defined by Jack and Lazaro’s use of fine luxury materials, consistently infused with a marked sense of effortlessness and ease. Since its inception, Proenza Schouler has played an important role in reinvigorating American fashion. Awarded with the inaugural CFDA Vogue Fashion Fund award in 2004, the emerging brand was quickly established as a leading talent in the industry. Proenza Schouler has won five CFDA awards, including the 2003 Swarovski award for Ready-to-Wear, the 2009 Accessory Designer of the Year award, and the Womenswear Designer of the Year award in 2007, 2011, and 2013.  
  
Proenza Schouler launched its first handbag collection in 2008, including the PS1, a classic satchel that embodies a sense of wearable luxury that has become the brand’s signature. In 2012, the brand launched their footwear collection which completed their luxury accessories offering. Proenza Schouler has also collaborated with leading brands, including L’Oréal, Birkenstock, and Mercedes-Benz. In 2019, the brand’s secondary line Proenza Schouler White Label was launched. Proenza Schouler White Label derives much if its language from elements found throughout the history of the main line, but rendered in a more casual, accessible way.  
  
Proenza Schouler has a flagship boutique located at 121 Greene Street in New York, and is sold in over 350 doors worldwide, including Bergdorf Goodman, Saks Fifth Avenue, Nordstrom, Neiman Marcus, Net-A-Porter, Moda Operandi, and FarFetch.

About The Great Falls Clinic
----------------------------

The Great Falls Clinic is a multi-specialty group medical practice emphasizing primary practice care, medical specialties and urgent care. Founded in 1917, the Great Falls Clinic is the fourth oldest medical clinic west of the Mississippi. Originally based on the vision that quality healthcare need not be confined to large urban centers, our mission today is focused on providing leadership in medicine through teamwork. To accomplish our goal, we strive to assess and meet the needs of the 225,000 residents living in the seventeen north central Montana counties that we serve.  
  
As a leader in the Great Falls medical delivery system, the Great Falls Clinic works hard as a team of providers to institute positive change for our patients throughout Montana. The combination of physicians and employees working together to improve patient care is our commitment and can be defined as “Team Care.” Our Team has a responsibility to constantly strive to perform better services and to create more value for the people we serve.  
  
The Great Falls Clinic is proud to be a physician-led and governed organization and we understand that with leadership comes responsibility. One thing that will not change moving forward is that we will continue to have physicians and employees working together to bring the population of Montana the best healthcare possible.

Since 1967, Cambrian College has been providing students of all ages with the education needed to launch successful and rewarding careers around the world. Cambrian graduates are equipped with the skills, knowledge, and hands-on experience to excel in the dynamic careers of today and tomorrow.  
  
The largest college in northern Ontario, Cambrian College has more than 4,000 full-time students, 80+ full-time programs, hundreds of Canadian and international degree pathways, and 900+ part-time Continuing Education courses.  
  
Flex Learning, apprenticeship, Dual Credit, corporate training, and Second Career programs are also offered to meet the diverse personal and professional goals of each student.  
  
\- 85% of Cambrian grads get jobs within 6 months of graduation  
\- 95% of employers are very satisfied with Cambrian grads  
\- 50,000+ graduates working around the world  
\- 100+ varsity athletes  
\- 15+ online/alternate delivery programs  
\- 20+ countries represented on campus  
\- More than $500,000 awarded annually to students in scholarships and bursaries  
  
Cambrian College offers programs in:  
Anishnaabe Studies, Business and Information Technology, Community Services, Creative Arts and Design, Engineering Technology, Environmental Studies, General Studies, Law and Justice, Health Science and Emergency Services, Skills and Trades Training, and Graduate Certificate Programs.

What types of leadership coaching services does Vantage Leadership Consulting offer?

Vantage Leadership Consulting provides a range of leadership coaching services tailored to meet the unique needs of individuals and organizations. Our offerings include executive coaching, leadership development programs, and high potential programs designed to enhance leadership skills and drive organizational success. Our experienced coaches work closely with clients to identify their goals, develop personalized action plans, and provide ongoing support to ensure sustainable growth.

How does Vantage Leadership Consulting approach succession planning?

At Vantage Leadership Consulting, we recognize that effective succession planning is critical for long-term organizational success. Our approach involves a comprehensive assessment of current leadership capabilities, identification of potential successors, and the development of tailored training and mentoring programs. We work collaboratively with organizations to create a succession plan that aligns with their strategic goals, ensuring a smooth transition and continuity in leadership.

What industries does Vantage Leadership Consulting serve?

Vantage Leadership Consulting serves a diverse range of industries, including healthcare, finance, manufacturing, technology, and family businesses. Our extensive experience across various sectors allows us to customize our leadership solutions to meet the specific challenges and opportunities faced by organizations in different fields. We leverage industry insights to provide relevant and impactful coaching and consulting services.

Can Vantage Leadership Consulting assist with board evaluations?

Yes, Vantage Leadership Consulting offers board evaluation services aimed at enhancing the effectiveness of governance structures. Our team conducts thorough assessments of board performance, including individual member contributions and overall board dynamics. We provide actionable feedback and recommendations to help boards improve their effectiveness, ensure alignment with organizational goals, and foster a culture of accountability and collaboration.

What is the purpose of assessment centers in leadership development?

Assessment centers are a key component of leadership development at Vantage Leadership Consulting. They are designed to evaluate an individual's leadership competencies through a series of simulations, exercises, and interviews. The purpose of these centers is to provide a comprehensive understanding of a candidate's strengths and areas for improvement, enabling organizations to make informed decisions about leadership development, succession planning, and talent management.

How does Vantage Leadership Consulting support family businesses?

Vantage Leadership Consulting understands the unique challenges faced by family businesses, including succession planning, governance, and conflict resolution. We offer specialized consulting services that focus on strengthening family dynamics, enhancing communication, and developing leadership capabilities within the family and the business. Our goal is to help family businesses thrive across generations by fostering a culture of collaboration and strategic planning.

About Office of the Chairman of the Joint Chiefs of Staff
---------------------------------------------------------

The Chairman of the Joint Chiefs of Staff (CJCS) is the highest-ranking military officer in the United States Armed Forces and is the principal military advisor to the President, the National Security Council, and the Secretary of Defense. U.S. Marine Gen. Joe Dunford is the 19th Chairman of the Joint Chiefs of Staff.The Joint Chiefs of Staff consist of the Chairman, the Vice Chairman, the Chief of Staff of the Army, the Chief of Naval Operations, the Chief of Staff of the Air Force, the Commandant of the Marine Corps and the Chief of the National Guard Bureau.The collective body of the Joint Chiefs of Staff (JCS) is headed by the Chairman (or the Vice Chairman in the Chairman's absence), who sets the agenda and presides over JCS meetings. Responsibilities as members of the Joint Chiefs of Staff take precedence over duties as the Chiefs of Military Services. The Chairman of the Joint Chiefs of Staff is the principal military adviser to the President, Secretary of Defense, and the National Security Council (NSC), however, all JCS members are by law military advisers, and they may respond to a request or voluntarily submit, through the Chairman, advice or opinions to the President, the Secretary of Defense, or NSC.

About U.S. Office of Personnel Management
-----------------------------------------

OPM works in several broad categories to recruit, retain and honor a world-class workforce for the American people. They manage Federal job announcement postings at USAJOBS.gov, and set policy on governmentwide hiring procedures. They conduct background investigations for prospective employees and security clearances across government, with hundreds of thousands of cases each year. They uphold and defend the merit systems in Federal civil service, making sure that the Federal workforce uses fair practices in all aspects of personnel management. They manage pension benefits for retired Federal employees and their families. They also administer health and other insurance programs for Federal employees and retirees. They provide training and development programs and other management tools for Federal employees and agencies. In many cases, they take the lead in developing, testing and implementing new governmentwide policies that relate to personnel issues. Altogether, they work to make the Federal government America’s model employer for the 21st century.

About Der Teufelhof Basel AG
----------------------------

We enchant our guests with the varied facets of gastronomy, the hotel industry and culture. For example, the Teufelhof Basel has two restaurants: the Bel Étage fine dining restaurant, which has one Michelin star, and the Weinstube bistro. The sumptuous offering is rounded off by a Café & Bar and the wine shop Falstaff, which is embedded in Basel’s historic city walls dating from the 11th and 13th centuries.  
  
In addition, Der Teufelhof Basel is a unique hotel with 33 rooms. These rooms are situated either in the historic building we call the Art Hotel, or in the more modern part of the building, the Gallery Hotel. The Art Hotel has eight rooms and one suite, all of which have been created as works of art to live in. Changing, thematically arranged exhibitions are held in the Gallery Hotel, which has 18 rooms, three junior suites and three suites.  
  
Other key elements of the cultural offering include the classically playful theatre and the various works of art, which can be marvelled at in and around the hotel.  
  
Our hope is for the Teufelhof to make visitors to the theatre aware of the culture surrounding food and the plastic arts, for gourmets to become inquisitive about theatre work, the art rooms and the exhibitions, and for admirers of the plastic arts to be taught to value the art of cooking and the stage.  
  
For us, the guest should be a partner. A partner on a joint voyage of discovery through the worlds of dining, the hotel industry, theatre and art.

The Massachusetts Daily Collegian publishes a wide range of content, including news articles, opinion pieces, sports coverage, arts and living features, and multimedia content such as videos and podcasts. How can students get involved with The Massachusetts Daily Collegian?

Students interested in getting involved with The Massachusetts Daily Collegian can apply for various positions, including writers, editors, photographers, and multimedia producers. How does The Massachusetts Daily Collegian fund its operations?

The Massachusetts Daily Collegian is independently funded and operates primarily through advertising revenue, subscriptions, and donations. As a student-run organization, it relies on the support of the UMass Amherst community and local businesses to sustain its operations and continue providing quality journalism.

Can I submit a letter to the editor or an opinion piece?

The Massachusetts Daily Collegian is published Monday through Thursday during the UMass Amherst academic calendar. What services does Imprivata offer for healthcare organizations?

Imprivata provides a range of services tailored for healthcare organizations, including single sign-on (SSO) solutions, multifactor authentication (MFA), secure text messaging, and patient identification systems. These services are designed to streamline clinical workflows, enhance security, and ensure compliance with healthcare regulations. By implementing Imprivata's solutions, healthcare providers can improve access to critical applications while safeguarding sensitive patient data.

How does Imprivata's single sign-on solution improve workflow efficiency?

Imprivata's single sign-on (SSO) solution simplifies the login process for healthcare professionals by allowing them to access multiple applications with a single set of credentials. This reduces the time spent logging in and out of various systems, enabling clinicians to focus more on patient care. Additionally, SSO enhances security by minimizing password fatigue and the likelihood of password-related breaches, as users are less inclined to use weak passwords.

What industries does Imprivata serve beyond healthcare?

While Imprivata primarily focuses on the healthcare sector, its solutions are also applicable to other mission-critical industries that require robust identity management and security measures. These industries include finance, government, and education, where secure access to sensitive data and compliance with regulatory standards are essential. Imprivata's technology can be adapted to meet the specific needs of various sectors, ensuring that organizations can protect their critical data and applications effectively.

What is the importance of multifactor authentication in Imprivata's solutions?

Multifactor authentication (MFA) is a critical component of Imprivata's security solutions, as it adds an additional layer of protection beyond just usernames and passwords. By requiring users to provide multiple forms of verification—such as a password and a temporary code sent to a mobile device—MFA significantly reduces the risk of unauthorized access to sensitive information. This is particularly important in healthcare, where protecting patient data is paramount to maintaining trust and compliance with regulations like HIPAA.

How does Imprivata support compliance with healthcare regulations?

Imprivata's solutions are designed to help healthcare organizations comply with various regulations, including HIPAA and HITECH. By implementing secure access controls, audit trails, and identity management practices, Imprivata ensures that sensitive patient information is protected and that organizations can demonstrate compliance during audits. Additionally, the streamlined workflows provided by Imprivata's technologies help reduce the risk of human error, further supporting regulatory adherence.

Can Imprivata's solutions integrate with existing healthcare IT systems?

Yes, Imprivata's solutions are designed to integrate seamlessly with a wide range of existing healthcare IT systems, including electronic health records (EHR), practice management systems, and other clinical applications. This interoperability allows healthcare organizations to enhance their security and workflow efficiency without needing to overhaul their current infrastructure. Imprivata works closely with clients to ensure that its solutions fit within their specific technology environments, providing a smooth implementation process.

As Alec Benjamin continues to captivate audiences with his heartfelt tunes and evocative lyrics, his star only continues to soar. In addition to her musical talents, Jewel is also an accomplished poet and author, having released a book of poetry titled "A Night Without Armor" in 1998. Her literary pursuits underscore her multifaceted creative abilities and her desire to express herself through various artistic mediums.  
  
Throughout her career, Jewel has earned numerous accolades for her contributions to music, including several Grammy Award nominations. Beyond her artistic endeavors, Jewel is also known for her philanthropy and advocacy work. She is an outspoken supporter of mental health awareness and has used her platform to raise awareness and reduce stigma surrounding mental illness. Her own experiences with homelessness and the challenges she faced early in her career have fueled her passion for giving back to those in need, and she has been involved in various charitable initiatives aimed at improving the lives of others. Her commitment to making a positive impact on the world is an integral part of her identity and has endeared her to fans who admire her not only for her music but also for her altruism and compassion.  
  
In the ever-evolving landscape of popular music, Jewel's timeless appeal and enduring relevance speak to the depth of her artistry and the connection she has forged with her audience. Her ability to translate personal experiences into universally resonant songs has solidified her status as a beloved figure in the music industry, and her continued dedication to her craft ensures that her legacy will endure for years to come. Jewel's music remains a source of solace and inspiration for countless listeners, and her influence on the singer-songwriter genre is immeasurable. About Carrie Brownstein

Carrie Brownstein is a multi-talented American musician, actress, writer, and comedian who has left an indelible mark on the entertainment industry. Known for her fierce guitar skills, witty humor, and genuine authenticity, Brownstein has captivated audiences through her music, acting, and comedic performances. Her dynamic presence and undeniable talent have made her a beloved figure in both the music and television worlds.  
  
Born in Seattle, Washington, in 1974, Brownstein developed a deep love for music at an early age. In her youth, she immersed herself in the thriving punk rock scene, where she found solace and inspiration. Brownstein's passion for music led her to form the influential riot grrrl band Sleater-Kinney in the late 1990s, alongside Corin Tucker and Janet Weiss. As a guitarist and vocalist, Brownstein helped shape the band's distinctive sound and powerful feminist message.  
  
Sleater-Kinney's music was characterized by its raw energy, thought-provoking lyrics, and complex guitar riffs, all of which became Brownstein's signature style. The band's unapologetic attitude and commitment to social justice resonated deeply with fans, and they quickly gained a devoted and passionate following. Throughout their career, Sleater-Kinney released several critically acclaimed albums, such as "Dig Me Out" and "The Woods," which solidified their place as one of the most influential bands of their time.  
  
In addition to her musical success, Brownstein has also made a significant impact in the world of acting. Her versatility and natural talent as a performer have allowed her to seamlessly transition between music and television, showcasing her range and depth. One of her most notable acting roles is that of the co-creator, writer, and star of the satirical sketch comedy series "Portlandia," alongside Fred Armisen. The show, which ran from 2011 to 2018, parodied the unique culture and quirks of Portland, Oregon, with Brownstein portraying a multitude of eccentric characters. Her comedic timing and ability to skewer societal norms made "Portlandia" a cult favorite and solidified Brownstein's status as a comedic genius.  
  
Beyond "Portlandia," Brownstein has also had success in more dramatic roles, such as her portrayal of Syd Feldman in the hit series "Transparent." About Steve Chen

Steve Chen, the former chief technology officer of YouTube, is an exemplary visionary and tech pioneer who played a pivotal role in revolutionizing the way the world consumes video content. With his profound understanding of technology and innate entrepreneurial spirit, Chen co-founded YouTube, which quickly became the go-to platform for users to upload, share, and discover videos across the globe.  
  
Born in Taiwan in 1978, Chen moved to the United States at the age of 15. He attended the University of Illinois at Urbana-Champaign, where he majored in computer science. It was during his time at university that Chen's passion for technology flourished, leading him to embark on a path that would shape the future of online video sharing.  
  
In 2005, Chen, along with his former PayPal colleagues Chad Hurley and Jawed Karim, founded YouTube. The trio recognized the untapped potential of the internet as a platform for people to share their experiences, creativity, and perspectives through video. They aimed to create a user-friendly platform that empowered individuals to connect and express themselves through this medium.  
  
As the chief technology officer of YouTube, Chen played a vital role in developing and refining the platform. With his technical expertise, he focused on ensuring that the infrastructure and systems could scale rapidly to accommodate the growing user base. Chen's contributions to the platform's architecture facilitated seamless video streaming, significantly improving user experience and cementing YouTube's dominance in the online video market.  
  
Under Chen's stewardship, YouTube witnessed an unprecedented surge in popularity. He not only oversaw the technological aspects of the platform but also played a crucial role in shaping its overall direction. YouTube's success was fueled by Chen's dedication to fostering a user-centric environment where creators could thrive.  
  
During his tenure as the CTO of YouTube, Chen was instrumental in spearheading several groundbreaking initiatives. One of his notable contributions was the development of the YouTube Partner Program, which revolutionized business models for online content creators. This program allowed users to earn revenue from their videos through advertisements, opening up new avenues for aspiring influencers and artists to monetize their creativity.  
  
Chen's unparalleled vision also led to the acquisition of YouTube by Google in 2006. This landmark deal not only demonstrated the platform's significant influence but also provided YouTube with the resources and technical support necessary for its continued growth. Chen's ability to anticipate industry trends and adapt to changing market dynamics played a crucial role in establishing YouTube as the undisputed leader in online video sharing.  
  
Today, Steve Chen continues to make a considerable impact on the tech industry. After leaving YouTube in 2008, he co-founded Avos Systems, a company focused on developing innovative applications and platforms. Chen's entrepreneurial endeavors demonstrate his unwavering commitment to pushing the boundaries of technology and exploring new avenues for digital media consumption.  
  
Steve Chen's legacy as the former chief technology officer of YouTube is profound and far-reaching. His accomplishments have not only revolutionized the way we consume and share video content but have also empowered countless individuals to express their creativity and connect with others on a global scale. Chen's unwavering dedication to user experience and his innovative spirit will forever be celebrated as he continues to shape the future of technology.

About Bad Wolf
--------------

Bad Wolf was founded to create ambitious, imaginative and relevant drama for the UK, US and global TV markets. An independent scripted production company based in South Wales, London and Los Angeles, Bad Wolf is the result of over 15 years of creative collaboration between founders Jane Tranter, Julie Gardner and the production and creative community of Wales.  
  
Just as the ninth Doctor’s companion Rose Tyler scattered a message to the Doctor via BAD WOLF, throughout time and space, the Bad Wolf team has sent a message to the world that Wales is a centre of creative excellence, built around a vibrant production industry.  
  
Enjoying a strong partnership and launched with support from Welsh Government, Bad Wolf founded Wolf Studios Wales, a world class production facility in Cardiff, and Screen Alliance Wales, an education and training scheme to engage with emerging talent to grow, nurture and build skills across the creative industries.  
  
Filming in Wales transformed the lives of founders Jane and Julie. After working all over the world, they knew there was only one choice of home for their new production company, Bad Wolf. Wales had the breadth, depth and capability necessary to grow its creative industries.  
  
In founding Bad Wolf Jane and Julie have started a production company that is creating drama with global reach, that is building worldwide momentum for the local industry with the ambition to provide employment 52 weeks of the year for the crews and establishing Wales as a long lasting centre of excellence.

-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

For 60 years as a global commercial manufacturer of lighting control equipment, we have engineered scalable, easy-to-install centralized and decentralized digital lighting control systems for schools, offices, commercial buildings, campuses and sports complexes throughout North America. Douglas systems include relay panels, controllers, occupancy/vacancy sensors, daylight sensors and wall switch stations. Each system is built to order in our North American production facility. Prior to shipment, each system is programmed and tested to ensure the system installation and commissioning are as fast and easy as possible. We also provide services for project / system drawing, technical support, and onsite system commissioning. We are recognized for our deep understanding of the lighting control market, our staff expertise, and the ability to provide the right solution for each facility.

About Chris Hoiles

Chris Hoiles, a former MLB catcher for the Baltimore Orioles from 1989 to 1998, now channels his extensive experience and passion for the game into his role as the Owner of Gold Glove Sports Academy. At the academy, Chris is dedicated to developing young athletes not only in their technical skills but also in their mental resilience. His approach to teaching hitting mechanics emphasizes the importance of driving the ball rather than merely making contact. By focusing on key elements such as maintaining flat hands at contact, getting to the ball, and staying through the ball, Chris equips his players with the foundational skills necessary for success on the field.  
  
Beyond the physical aspects of the game, Chris recognizes that mental toughness is often the differentiating factor for players striving to reach their full potential. At Gold Glove Sports Academy, he implements strategies to cultivate this mental fortitude, helping athletes overcome challenges and develop a winning mindset. His expertise extends beyond hitting mechanics; Chris is also adept at new business development, marketing strategy, and personal training, ensuring that the academy not only provides top-notch instruction but also thrives in a competitive sports landscape.  
  
With a strong presence on social media and a knack for public speaking, Chris actively engages with the community, sharing insights and promoting the academy's mission. His commitment to fostering a positive and growth-oriented environment for young athletes positions Gold Glove Sports Academy as a premier destination for aspiring baseball players looking to hone their skills and mental game under the guidance of a seasoned professional.

About TheDream.US
-----------------

Our Vision  
  
All DREAMers should have the opportunity to realize the American dream of obtaining a college education and contributing to the prosperity of our nation.  
  
Our Mission  
  
THEDREAM.US provides college scholarships to highly motivated DREAMers who, without financial aid, cannot afford a college education that will enable them to participate in the American workforce.  
  
Our Belief  
  
We believe the cost of a college education should not preclude highly motivated DREAMers with the commitment and desire to succeed, from going to college. We are the “Pell Grant” for DREAMers. Based on this belief and the need, we have created a fund that provides DREAMers with scholarships for quality, affordable college educations that lead to career-ready degrees. The goal is to enable over 2,000 highly motivated, low-income, DREAMers to graduate with career-ready degrees over the course of the next decade.

About Academic Senate For California Community Colleges
-------------------------------------------------------

The Academic Senate for California Community Colleges (ASCCC) plays a pivotal role in enhancing the academic landscape of California's community colleges. Headquartered in Sacramento, California, the ASCCC is dedicated to fostering effective participation by faculty in both statewide and local academic and professional matters. By developing, promoting, and acting upon policies that address statewide concerns, the ASCCC serves as the official voice of faculty in these institutions, ensuring that their insights and expertise are recognized in the decision-making processes that shape education in California.  
  
One of the primary missions of the ASCCC is to strengthen and support local senates across all California community colleges, empowering faculty to engage in governance and advocate for their students and institutions. This collaboration not only enhances the quality of education but also promotes a culture of shared governance, where faculty members actively contribute to the academic integrity and effectiveness of their colleges.  
  
For those interested in understanding the faculty landscape, the ASCCC provides resources such as the Academic Senate For California Community Colleges teachers list, which highlights the diverse and dedicated educators committed to advancing community college education. Through workshops, conferences, and ongoing professional development, the ASCCC equips faculty with the tools they need to excel in their roles, ultimately benefiting students and the broader community. By championing faculty voices and fostering collaboration, the ASCCC continues to be a vital force in shaping the future of California's community colleges.

About Hualan Biological Engineering Inc.
----------------------------------------

Founded in 1992, Hualan Biological Engineering Inc. (Hualan Bio) is a key National high-tech biopharmaceutical company in China engaging in the research, development, production, and commercialization of plasma products, viral vaccines, bacterial vaccines, and recombinant proteins and other biologics. Hualan Bio was the first company whose plasma products gained GMP certificate in China, the first listed company of plasma products, the first H1N1 Influenza Vaccine manufacturer in the whole world, the first influenza vaccine manufacturer passing WHO-PQ in China. Passing "ISO9000" (quality), "ISO14000" (environment) and "GBT28000" (occupational health) management system certification.  
  
  
  
As a major manufacturer for the plasma products and vaccines designated by national authorities, Hualan Bio is the largest manufacturer and provider for both plasma products and influenza vaccines in Asia. Hualan Bio is the leading company which has integrated the innovative R & D activities, state-of the-art technologies, scientific management styles and high standard quality control and assurance systems in China. The company has been undertaking research projects from national, provincial and municipal organizations. In 2010, Hualan Bio formed a strategic alliance with the Chinese Academy of Sciences (CAS) and collaborates with several institutes for the discovery of innovative biologics. Recently, the R & D center at Hualan Bio was recognized as one of the National High-tech Center in China, which built the solid foundation for the development of novel products and future growth.  
Driven by the mission “Dedicating for Human Healthcare”, Hualan Bio has made a significant effort and successfully developed and manufactured a number of products such as human Albumin, IVIG, PCC, Fibrin Sealant, Factor VIII, Seasonal Influenza Vaccine, H1N1 Vaccine, ACYW135 Meningococcal Polysaccharide Vaccine.  
Now Hualan Bio is one of the largest biological company in China.

About Qdoba Restaurant Corporation
----------------------------------

Getting our start in 1995, QDOBA Mexican Eats now has more than 740 restaurants in the U.S. and Canada. While our footprint has grown tremendously in the last two decades, we’ve always stayed true to our brand promise: bringing flavor to people’s lives. We do this by ensuring every ingredient that goes into our guests’ burritos, tacos, salads, nachos, bowls, and quesadillas is full of flavor.  
  
Our most important ingredient to our success, though, is our people. We look for team members that are not only talented, creative and optimistic, but are willing to stay true to themselves. We encourage them to celebrate their uniqueness and express, what we like to call, their flavor. That’s because, we believe when everyone’s flavor is united, a truly great brand is possible.  
  
When we’re not busy working on the next great QDOBA dish, we’re most likely participating in some office fun. From free snacks and surprise catered lunches to burrito rolling competitions and impromptu dance parties, no day at our headquarters is dull. QDOBA employees can also expect mentoring programs, community involvement opportunities and tuition reimbursement.  
  
Think you have what it takes? Learn more about us at qdoba.com and connect with us on Facebook, Instagram, Twitter, and TikTok.

About Accelerated Enrollment Solutions
--------------------------------------

Accelerated Enrollment Solutions (AES), headquartered in Horsham, PA, is a pivotal player in the biopharmaceutical industry, dedicated to addressing the critical challenges of patient recruitment and clinical research site management. By leveraging a robust patient recruiting solution and an extensive network of over 160 owned and partnered clinical research sites globally, AES empowers biopharmaceutical companies to enhance the speed, certainty, and control of their clinical trial delivery.  
  
AES operates as a business unit of PPD, a renowned global contract research organization (CRO) that offers comprehensive drug development, laboratory, and lifecycle management services. This affiliation allows AES to integrate seamlessly into the broader clinical research ecosystem, providing clients with centralized control and consistent operational quality across diverse geographical locations.  
  
The company’s innovative approach ensures that clinical trials can recruit more patients from fewer sites in less time, significantly improving operational efficiency. AES utilizes advanced technologies and data-driven methodologies to streamline the recruitment process, ensuring that trials meet their enrollment targets while maintaining high standards of patient care and compliance.  
  
With a focus on delivering tailored solutions to the biopharmaceutical sector, AES is committed to transforming the clinical trial landscape, making it more efficient and accessible for both sponsors and patients. For more information about their services and capabilities, visit www.globalAES.com.

What services does Accelerated Enrollment Solutions (AES) offer to biopharmaceutical companies?

Accelerated Enrollment Solutions (AES) provides a comprehensive range of services designed to support biopharmaceutical companies throughout the clinical trial process. Key services include patient recruitment, feasibility assessments, patient engagement strategies, and study start-up support. AES leverages a global site network to enhance patient enrollment and retention, ensuring that clinical trials are conducted efficiently and effectively.

How does AES improve patient recruitment for clinical trials?

AES employs a multi-faceted approach to enhance patient recruitment. This includes utilizing advanced analytics to identify suitable patient populations, engaging with patients through targeted outreach and education, and leveraging a global network of clinical trial sites. By focusing on patient-centric strategies, AES aims to streamline the recruitment process and reduce time to enrollment, ultimately leading to faster trial completion.

What industries does AES support in their clinical trial efforts?

AES primarily supports the biopharmaceutical industry, including companies involved in drug development across various therapeutic areas. This includes pharmaceuticals, biotechnology, and medical device manufacturers. By providing tailored solutions to meet the unique challenges of each industry, AES helps ensure that clinical trials are conducted successfully and efficiently.

Can AES assist with global clinical trials?

Yes, AES has extensive experience in managing global clinical trials. The company has established a robust global site network that allows for efficient patient recruitment and data collection across multiple countries. AES understands the regulatory and logistical complexities of conducting trials internationally and provides the expertise needed to navigate these challenges, ensuring compliance and successful trial outcomes.

What is the significance of patient centricity in AES's approach?

Patient centricity is a core principle of AES's approach to clinical trials. By prioritizing the needs and preferences of patients, AES enhances engagement and retention throughout the trial process. This includes designing studies that are more accessible and convenient for participants, as well as providing clear communication and support. By focusing on the patient experience, AES aims to improve enrollment rates and ensure that trials yield meaningful results.

How does AES conduct feasibility assessments for clinical trials?

AES conducts thorough feasibility assessments to evaluate the potential for successful patient recruitment and site performance for clinical trials. This process involves analyzing demographic data, site capabilities, and historical performance metrics. By gathering insights from a variety of sources, AES can provide biopharmaceutical companies with actionable recommendations and a clear understanding of the likelihood of meeting enrollment targets, ultimately aiding in informed decision-making for trial planning.

About Estes Park Economic Development Corporation
-------------------------------------------------

The Estes Park EDC was established in August 2013 due to the recognized need for a sustained, systemic economic development effort for the Estes Valley and surrounding region. Economic development is an important component of the quality of life for all residents.  
  
The Estes Park Economic Development Corporation (Estes Park EDC) mission is to plan for and promote the economic development of the Estes Valley in ways that are compatible with those qualities that make Estes Park a unique mountain community. The Corporation exists to build a stronger and more broadly-based economy and tax base; to advise and assist existing local businesses to reach their full economic potential; and to attract new businesses that create primary jobs and new employment opportunities.  
  
Estes Park EDC Projects:  
  
The Estes Park EDC Entrepreneur Center (E-Center) is the premier business incubator program in the Estes Valley. Through partnerships with Larimer SBDC and Innosphere Ventures, a successful 20-year business incubator with locations throughout Colorado, the Estes Park EDC E-Center provides customized, hands on assistance and business resources to Estes Valley startups and scale-ups.  
  
As part of our continued strategic plan, the Estes Park EDC Board of Directors agreed to initiate a Business Expansion And Retention Program called the BEAR Program. The goal of this program is to directly work with and help our existing businesses grow. To do this we reach out to as broad a representation of businesses in our community as possible and meeting with them regularly.  
  
Today, the Estes Park EDC helps facilitate private investment and public-private partnerships to address the workforce housing needs in the Estes Valley. The Workforce Housing Task Force includes the Town of Estes Park & The Estes Park Housing Authority.

Kasasa's marketing automation platform allows community banks and credit unions to streamline their marketing efforts through targeted campaigns, personalized messaging, and data-driven insights. However, its marketing and technology solutions can also be beneficial to other sectors that prioritize customer engagement and community involvement. By providing tailored marketing strategies and innovative financial products, Kasasa helps institutions in various industries enhance their customer relationships and drive growth.

How does Kasasa support customer service for financial institutions?

Kasasa supports customer service for financial institutions by providing comprehensive training and resources to help staff effectively communicate the benefits of Kasasa products to customers. Additionally, Kasasa offers ongoing support and consultation to ensure that community banks and credit unions can address customer inquiries and concerns efficiently. At Army Futures Command, we believe in using the Nation's top talent - whatever the source - to create innovative solutions faster and better. While this is an open forum, it's also a family friendly one, so please keep your comments and posts clean. You participate at your own risk, taking personal responsibility for your comments, your username and any information provided.  
  
Comments and posts that violate any of the guidelines listed below may be removed:  
  
\- Do not post graphic, obscene, explicit or racial comments. We also do not allow comments that are abusive, hateful, vindictive or intended to defame anyone or any organization.  
\- Do not post any solicitations (i.e.: asking users to "like" your social media page, visit your website, sign a petition, contribute to a fundraiser).  
\- Do not post advertisements, prize contests or giveaways. This includes promotion or endorsement of any financial, commercial or non-governmental agency. Similarly, we do not allow attempts to defame or defraud any financial, commercial or non-governmental agency.  
\- Do not post details about an ongoing investigation or legal or administrative proceeding that could prejudice the processes or could interfere with an individual's rights will be deleted from this page.  
\- Do not post copyrighted or trademarked images or graphics. Imagery posted on AFC social media platforms should be owned by the user.  
\- Do not post comments, photos or videos that suggest or encourage illegal activity.  
\- Do not post political propaganda.  
  
All information posted to social media sites will be unclassified. No FOUO (for official use only) content.

About Rick Sanghera

Rick Sanghera, as the CEO and Co-Founder of AtaCor Medical, Inc., is at the forefront of innovation in the field of implantable cardiac devices. With over 25 years of experience, Rick's journey began as an engineer at Guidant, where he honed his technical skills and developed a deep understanding of cardiac rhythm management systems. His early exposure to the field ignited a passion for continuous improvement, driving him to explore new avenues for enhancing patient care.  
  
At AtaCor Medical, Rick is leading the development of groundbreaking extravascular cardiac rhythm management systems. This next-generation technology aims to revolutionize how pacing and defibrillation are performed, offering a safer and more efficient alternative to traditional transvenous methods. One of the key projects under his leadership is the development of a temporary pacing lead that can be inserted in minutes without the need for fluoroscopy, significantly reducing procedure time and improving patient outcomes.  
  
Rick's expertise spans a wide range of disciplines, including biomedical engineering, biotechnology, and regulatory affairs. His ability to lead cross-functional teams has been instrumental in navigating the complexities of life sciences commercialization, ensuring that innovative solutions meet stringent quality system requirements. As a thought leader in cardiology, Rick is committed to advancing the field by leveraging his extensive knowledge and experience to bring transformative technologies to market. Under his guidance, AtaCor Medical is poised to make a lasting impact on the future of cardiac care, ultimately enhancing the lives of patients worldwide.

What types of club sports are offered at Liberty University?

How can students get involved in club sports at Liberty University?

Students interested in joining club sports at Liberty University can start by visiting the Club Sports website, where they can find information about different teams, schedules, and tryout dates. Are club sports at Liberty University competitive?

His contributions to the field of mathematics extend beyond TCU, as he frequently participates in national and international conferences, sharing his insights and research findings with a global audience. About Sterling Planet
---------------------

Sterling Planet helps businesses and individuals meet and exceed their renewable energy and environmental sustainability goals. We offer renewable energy certificates (RECs) as an easy, affordable way to reduce the impact of everyday electricity use. Our business extends to a comprehensive portfolio of solutions that includes carbon offsets, energy efficiency certificates, green power project development, and green partnerships with electricity and natural gas providers.  
  
Since 2000, Sterling Planet has delivered innovative solutions to clients in both voluntary and compliance markets that center around how energy is produced, consumed and managed. Inspired by what the world can be, our mission is to improve lives today while working to sustain Earth for future generations. Sterling Planet is committed to growing the renewable industry by staying keenly focused on triple bottom line results: social responsibility, environmental protection and economic performance.

Who are the decision makers in Sterling Planet?

.

What are Renewable Energy Certificates (RECs) and how do they work?

Renewable Energy Certificates (RECs) are tradable commodities that represent proof that 1 megawatt-hour (MWh) of renewable energy has been generated and added to the power grid. When you purchase RECs, you are supporting the generation of renewable energy, which helps reduce your carbon footprint. By acquiring RECs, businesses and individuals can claim that they are using renewable energy, even if the electricity they consume comes from traditional sources.

How can Sterling Planet help my business achieve its sustainability goals?

Sterling Planet offers a range of services designed to help businesses meet their renewable energy and sustainability objectives. We provide customized solutions that include purchasing RECs, carbon offsets, and assistance with renewable energy project development. Our team can also help you implement energy efficiency programs and explore microgrid development, ensuring that your sustainability strategy is comprehensive and effective.

What industries does Sterling Planet support with its services?

Sterling Planet supports a diverse range of industries, including commercial real estate, manufacturing, education, healthcare, and government. Our services are tailored to meet the unique sustainability needs of each sector, helping organizations reduce their environmental impact while also achieving compliance with regulatory requirements and enhancing their corporate social responsibility initiatives.

What are carbon offsets and how can they benefit my organization?

Carbon offsets are reductions in greenhouse gas emissions that are used to compensate for emissions produced elsewhere. By purchasing carbon offsets through Sterling Planet, your organization can effectively neutralize its carbon footprint. This not only helps combat climate change but also enhances your brand's reputation as a socially responsible entity. Our offsets are sourced from verified projects that meet rigorous standards, ensuring that your investment has a meaningful impact.

Can Sterling Planet assist with LEED certification for my building?

Yes, Sterling Planet can assist with LEED (Leadership in Energy and Environmental Design) certification by providing the necessary renewable energy credits and guidance on sustainable practices. Our expertise in renewable energy project development and energy efficiency programs can help your building meet the criteria for LEED certification, contributing to improved energy performance and environmental sustainability.

What is microgrid development and how can it benefit my community?

Microgrid development involves creating localized energy systems that can operate independently or in conjunction with the main power grid. These systems enhance energy resilience, reduce reliance on fossil fuels, and support the integration of renewable energy sources. Sterling Planet can help communities design and implement microgrids that improve energy security, lower costs, and promote sustainability, ultimately benefiting residents and local businesses.

About Calistoga Bakery Cafe
---------------------------

Calistoga is a small town nestled in the Upper Napa Valley of California. As with the entire valley, the air is rich with the scent of deliciously fresh prepared meals. Every open door you pass is alive with the sound of people enjoying a meal together with their friends and neighbors. We are delighted to bring the charm, the food and the uncomplicated lifestyle of Napa Valley to you. Better, simply better.  
  
The things we give you are: Gourmet soups, salads and sandwiches, artisan breads and pastries, custom roasted coffees and espresso, welcoming service, and the sense of community.  
  
Come in for a breakfast, lunch or dinner, stay as long as you’d like. We love to see our friends several times a day.  
  
Have a seat next to the comfort of our fireplace, or enjoy the outside on our fountain patio or the quiet in the privacy of our high back booths.  
  
The hearth deck oven is the beating heart of the cafe. Feel free to close your eyes and let the aroma transport you.  
  
We’re a neighborhood bakery cafe and like our neighbors we are made richer by contrast: Rustic hardwood floors meet warm concrete, and old world craft sustains the latest technology. Through it all moves the spirit of Calistoga: You’re always welcome here. You’ll always have a place to sit and relax, to take a break from your day in the company of friends, to enjoy . . . better, simply better.

About Meineke Car Care Centers, Inc.
------------------------------------

Proudly serving America since 1972, Meineke has an unparalleled reputation for customer service and quality workmanship. With over 900 Meineke Car Care Center franchises located throughout the United States and around the world, we continue to be the most recognized, trusted and revered brand in automotive repair.  
  
Meineke is one of the cornerstone franchise companies of Driven Brands, the nation's leading automotive franchise holding company with nearly 2,700 units operating throughout North America. Driven Brands provides management services and synergies to not only Meineke, but also Maaco, CARSTAR, Econo Lube N'​ Tune, 1-800 Radiator, and our Mobile Services Division. The collective power and support of the nation's leading automotive aftermarket companies creates a secure and one-of-a-kind, entrepreneurial opportunity.  
  
Meineke has come a long way since 1972 in Houston, Texas when Sam Meineke began with only one store and a single product line. He also started with a simple concept: he would provide quality products and workmanship at a fair price and repair vehicles correctly, the first time. Today, still based on Sam's ideals, Meineke is one of the most recognized and trusted brands in North America.  
  
We have successfully adapted our automotive franchise system to the one-stop model that today's consumer are looking for. Our franchisees share a nationally recognized name, a broad range of services, hands-on training, and a system that's geared to business success.  
  
So if cars make you tick, or if you’d like to find someone to help your car get over its tick, we’d love to hear from you. For more information, visit us at www.meineke.com or www.meinekecareers.com for job information.

This initiative is crucial as TotalEnergies adapts to the fast-paced changes brought about by smart meters and the broader energy transition. Her leadership is characterized by a deep understanding of customer relationship management (CRM), digital marketing, and operations management, which she utilizes to drive impactful marketing strategies and enhance customer satisfaction. Armelle’s commitment to fostering a customer-centric culture is evident in her approach to restructuring and optimizing processes, ensuring that TotalEnergies remains agile and responsive in a competitive marketplace. Daniel and Frank Glaser started Heirloom because they were dissatisfied with the typical short-term home rental experience. They wanted guests to enjoy consistent, high-quality home rentals that feel connected to the local culture and community and offer ample space to come together as a group.  
  
They found the only way to guarantee this level of guest satisfaction was to manage and renovate each home to their exacting standards. By hiring local support teams to make sure travelers are genuinely connected to the cities they want to explore, they could provide a curated experience that cannot be replicated.  
  
When they purchased their first homes in Boston and New Orleans, Frank and Dan used family heirlooms to fill the home. These pieces were full of history and meaning. This allowed the creation of something that cannot be ordered online or mass produced. And thus, Heirloom was born.  
  
Now operating with 100+ properties in major travel destinations such as New York, New Orleans, Austin, and Boston, Heirloom is well on its way to accomplishing its mission: ensuring that every guest has a world-class hospitality experience worth sharing.

Born in 1965 in London, Glazer began his career in the world of advertising, where he honed his skills as a director and developed a keen eye for visual storytelling. He quickly made a name for himself in the industry, creating memorable and impactful commercials for prestigious brands such as Guinness, Levi's, and Sony.  
  
In 2000, Glazer made his feature film debut with "Sexy Beast," a crime thriller that received widespread critical acclaim and solidified his reputation as a filmmaking force to be reckoned with. The film, which starred Ray Winstone and Ben Kingsley, was praised for its intense and gritty portrayal of the criminal underworld, as well as for its impeccable direction and strong performances.  
  
Glazer followed up "Sexy Beast" with the enigmatic and visually stunning "Birth" in 2004, further establishing his reputation as a director with a unique vision and a penchant for pushing boundaries. The film, which starred Nicole Kidman, delved into themes of love, loss, and identity, and was lauded for its haunting atmosphere and thought-provoking narrative. Glazer's ability to create a sense of unease and tension through his use of imagery and sound design was particularly praised, cementing his status as a master of mood and atmosphere.  
  
However, it was with his 2013 film "Under the Skin" that Glazer truly solidified his status as a visionary filmmaker. Starring Scarlett Johansson as an otherworldly being preying on unsuspecting men, the film was a mesmerizing and unsettling exploration of humanity, alienation, and the nature of identity. Glazer's meticulous attention to detail and his ability to create a sense of unease and wonder through his use of imagery and sound design won the film widespread acclaim, earning him several awards and nominations, including a BAFTA nomination for Best Director.  
  
One of the most striking aspects of Glazer's work is his ability to tell deeply emotional and thought-provoking stories through the use of visually stunning and innovative techniques. His films are often characterized by their dreamlike quality, with sequences that are as beautiful as they are disconcerting. Glazer's keen understanding of the power of image and sound allows him to create a sense of unease and wonder, drawing audiences into his immersive and often unsettling worlds.  
  
In addition to his work as a director, Glazer has also made a name for himself as a talented screenwriter, crafting intricate and captivating narratives that explore the depths of the human experience. His ability to create complex and layered characters, as well as his knack for creating tension and suspense, has earned him a reputation as a master storyteller with a unique and powerful voice.  
  
Jonathan Glazer's impact on the world of film cannot be overstated. With his visually stunning and emotionally powerful work, he has established himself as a director and screenwriter of extraordinary talent and vision. His films are not only feats of technical mastery, but also powerful explorations of the human experience, leaving audiences with a lasting impact long after the credits have rolled. As he continues to push the boundaries of storytelling and visual expression, Jonathan Glazer remains a formidable force in the world of cinema, leaving an indelible mark on the industry and inspiring future generations of filmmakers to come.

About Carlos Villaumbrosia

Carlos Gonzalez De Villaumbrosia is a visionary entrepreneur and the founder of Product School, a pioneering institution in product management training. With over 15 years of experience in building global companies and digital products, Carlos has established himself as a thought leader in the product management space. Under his leadership, Product School has grown to become the global leader in product training, boasting a vibrant community of over two million members. This expansive network not only fosters collaboration among product professionals but also serves as a vital resource for aspiring product managers seeking to enhance their skills.  
  
As the author of "The Product Book," Carlos has distilled his extensive knowledge into a comprehensive guide that empowers readers to navigate the complexities of product management. His expertise spans various critical areas, including product marketing, artificial intelligence, and agile methodologies, making him a sought-after speaker and mentor in the industry. Carlos is deeply committed to bridging the gap between theoretical knowledge and practical application, ensuring that all instructors at Product School are seasoned product leaders from top Silicon Valley companies like Google and Facebook. This real-world experience enriches the curriculum, providing students with insights that are directly applicable in today’s fast-paced tech environment.  
  
In addition to his role at Product School, Carlos is passionate about fostering innovation and entrepreneurship. He actively engages with the product community through public speaking and workshops, sharing his insights on product development and business intelligence. His dedication to empowering the next generation of product managers is evident in every initiative he undertakes, solidifying his status as a key influencer in the field.

About Karen Khachanov

Karen Khachanov is a rising star within the world of professional tennis. Hailing from Russia, Khachanov has quickly made a name for himself with his powerful game and unwavering determination on the court. Standing at an impressive 6 feet 6 inches tall, he possesses the physical attributes that allow him to dominate his opponents with his aggressive style of play.  
  
Born on May 21, 1996, in Moscow, Khachanov was exposed to tennis at a young age. His father, an engineer, played recreationally and Khachanov would often accompany him to the tennis courts. It wasn't long before he developed a passion for the sport and began dedicating himself to its practice. By the age of five, Khachanov was already showing immense potential, and his parents decided to enroll him in a tennis academy to further nurture his skills.  
  
Under the guidance of his coaches, Khachanov quickly progressed through the ranks of junior tennis. His powerful strokes and exceptional footwork caught the attention of tennis enthusiasts and professionals alike. By the time he turned 16, he made the decision to pursue a professional career, a decision that would ultimately shape his future.  
  
In 2013, Khachanov turned pro and began competing on the ATP Challenger Tour. It didn't take long for him to make his mark in the professional circuit. In 2015, he reached his first ATP Challenger final, demonstrating his ability to compete at a high level. The following year, he broke into the top 100 in the ATP rankings, solidifying his place among the best tennis players in the world.  
  
Khachanov's breakthrough moment came in 2018 when he lifted the biggest trophy of his career at the Paris Masters. This victory not only marked his first ATP Masters 1000 title but also signaled his arrival as a force to be reckoned with in the tennis world. In the final, he defeated Novak Djokovic, a tennis legend and former world number one, in straight sets. This performance propelled him into the top ten of the ATP rankings for the first time.  
  
Known for his powerful serve and aggressive groundstrokes, Khachanov's playing style is reminiscent of the giants of the game. His booming forehand and lightning-fast backhand allow him to dictate play and put his opponents on the backfoot. Furthermore, his exceptional footwork enables him to get into optimal positions on the court, turning defense into offense effortlessly.  
  
Off the court, Khachanov exudes a calm and focused demeanor. He credits his mental strength as a crucial aspect of his success, enabling him to stay composed during high-pressure situations. This resilience has allowed him to overcome challenges and bounce back from setbacks, a characteristic that is vital in the competitive world of professional tennis.  
  
Khachanov continues to strive for even greater success in his career. With his determination and hunger for victory, he has set his sights on winning Grand Slam titles and becoming the number one player in the world. As he continues to refine his game and gain experience, there is no doubt that he has the potential to achieve these lofty goals.  
  
In conclusion, Karen Khachanov is a rising star in Russian tennis. With his exceptional physical attributes, powerful game, and unwavering determination, he has quickly established himself as a force to be reckoned with in the professional circuit. His breakthrough victory at the Paris Masters catapulted him into the top ten of the ATP rankings, and he continues to strive for even greater success. With his aggressive style of play and mental resilience, Khachanov is destined for a bright future in the world of tennis.

About Leadership Tulsa
----------------------

Want to learn more about Tulsa? Want to develop your leadership skills? Want to make connections that last a lifetime . . . Leadership Tulsa has a program for you!  
  
Our traditional LEADERSHIP TULSA program is offered twice a year and provides a 360 view of Tulsa, it's history as well as its current opportunities and challenges. Applications due in April and October of each year for programs that start in August and January.  
  
Our newest program, THRIVE TULSA, is a deep dive into personal leadership development for people who are passionate about a project, cause, community or want to develop skills working on adaptive challenges we may face in our workplace. Especially seeking those working in under-served communities.  
  
NEW VOICES board internship program helps to add diversity to Tulsa area boards by finding individuals from historically under-represented groups with a heart for community service and placing them in board service in partnership with the Tulsa Area United Way.  
  
The HISPANIC LEADERSHIP INSTITUTE builds knowledge, skills and connections of emerging Latinx leaders in a way that celebrates their culture and believes in their promise. Presented in partnership with the Tulsa Area Hispanic Chamber.

About Bark
----------

Bark is awesome! Bark is the resource for community action to protect Mt. Hood National Forest and surrounding federal lands. We prioritize grassroots organizing and believe in the power of an engaged public. We recognize that the forest should thrive not just to provide resources for the human community, but also for the inherent value of nature itself. We maintain an organizational culture that is transparent, inclusive and cooperative, where volunteers, staff and board work together to realize the vision of Bark.  
  
What does BARK stand for?  
Bark’s name originates from the barker, who stands before the public and uses persistent outcry to call attention. We are a group of barkers, ensuring that the public hears about all events, good and bad, occurring in the Mt. Hood National Forest.
